items.quote: We currently have a couple of hundred residents under management. These are senior residents under management across 6 centers in the West. And our pipeline is a few x times of those for the coming quarter.

items.statement: Mihup has contracted ARR of INR1 billion with clients like Tata Motors, Canara HSBC, Angel Broking, Pine Labs, HDFC
items.quote: Mihup currently has contracted ARR of INR1 billion. It accounts for Tata Motors, Canara HSBC, Angel Broking and Pine Labs among the top clients. Recently, it signed a multimillion-dollar contract with the Tata Motors with significant greater acceptance of its products. It has also onboarded HDFC as one of its clients d

items.statement: Pencil signed USD950,000 service deal for 36 months; Q4 FY26 revenue INR320 lakhs
items.quote: They have signed a USD950,000 service deal with a leading organization for a period of 36 months. Its revenue for January to March '26 was INR320 lakhs.

items.statement: Runway available for 10-12 months at current burn rate
items.quote: So right now, runway is available for close to about 10 to 12 months.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of INR 650-675 crores with EBITDA margin of 18-20%
items.quote: Guidance for FY27, we expect revenue to be in the range of INR 650-675 crores with an EBITDA margin of around 18-20%, supported by incremental capacities from Dahej and Jhagadia and an improved product mix through the year.

items.statement: MCC 12,000 MT expansion at Dahej costing INR 106 crores; CCS 1,800 MT facility costing INR 90 crores
items.quote: MCC 12,000 metric tons, the CapEx is INR 106 crores, and CCS total project cost is around INR 90 crores.

items.statement: CCS pricing 2-3x MCC with higher margins; MCC pricing stable with volume recovery
items.quote: This CCS, but it gives higher profits, superior in excipient. And the price is, when we compare to MCC, almost two to three times higher than the MCC, and margins also on higher side.

items.statement: Export turnover 65% in FY26 (down from 72%); 60+ countries; demand exceeds supply; H2 stronger than H1
items.quote: The export turnover for FY26 is around 65% and we are exporting total in our portfolio around 60 plus countries are there. Actively, we supply the major chunk will go to the USA and neighboring countries and European and other countries also.

items.statement: Insurance claim INR 53.5 crores (asset/inventory) + INR 16.5 crores (business interruption) expected by June 30; Hyderabad plant legal matters sub judice
items.quote: Total, around INR 49 crores towards the fixed-asset loss and inventory loss of around INR 4.5 crores, total INR 53.5 crores. And also, apart from this, we are expecting business-interruption loss. We have a policy for INR 25 crores, and we are expecting around INR 16.5 crores.

items.statement: MCC capacity utilization 75-80% in Q4 FY26; targeting 95-97% on existing capacity; new 12,000 MT Dahej MCC by Q4 FY27; CCS commercialization Q1 FY28
items.quote: Now also as of now, as on 31st March, it is around 75-80% only. But going forward, it will increase in this year. In this quarter, already started. That will increase. And also further, at the end of the year, we are expecting another 12,000 metric tons.

items.statement: O&M EBITDA margins 21-22%; API margins expected 20%+; CCS margins >20%; MCC margins recovering from 13-14%
items.quote: The EBITDA margins, end up more steadily. It is around 21-22%. And the MCC, it is this time, it has come down post-accident. Otherwise, it will give from -- API, we are expecting more from this year, around 20-plus.

items.statement: Middle East JV on hold due to global situation; may resume in 6 months
items.quote: Because that present keeping you of the present global situation, sir. We just kept it on hold. Maybe after it comes to normalcy, the global war and all international situations, maybe after six months, we'll come some clarity.

items.statement: FY28 revenue not expected to reach INR 1,000 crores; targeting INR 1,000 crores by FY29
items.quote: Not in FY28. Okay, anyway, this is futuristic, but next year, we'll get more clarity. But definitely, we'll reach INR 1000 crores in not in FY28, I mean, maybe FY29 or so, we hope.

items.statement: Expect FY27 revenue growth slightly better than historical ~18% with visibility in H1
items.quote: As I said that our historical growth has been around 18%. So we expect it to be slightly better off is how we are looking at this financial year.

items.statement: Gross margins expected to remain in line with historical levels for FY27
items.quote: my sense would be that for a full year basis, it should be pretty much in line with what our historical gross margins have been.

items.statement: FY27 capex guided at INR 20-30 cr maintenance; topical facility addition possible in H2
items.quote: General capex is around to the tune of INR 20 crores, INR 30 crores. And as of now, there is no particular requirements per se.

items.statement: Solar savings to add 1-1.5% EBITDA; operating leverage from injectables and Stellon to add ~0.5%
items.quote: 1% to 1.5% should be from the power and around 0.5%, 50 bps from the rest of the business, one can look at that, yes.

items.statement: Injectable facility FY26 loss INR 38-39 cr; Stellon US subsidiary loss INR 10 cr/qtr; full costs booked in FY26
items.quote: the quarter-on-quarter expenses are around INR 10 crores, while the full year number would be around INR 38 crores to INR 39 crores.

items.statement: Growth driven by anti-infectives and oncology; Nystatin and Fusidic Acid ramping; CDMO 1-4% of API
items.quote: much of the growth that we are seeing or we are going to be seeing in this year would also be coming from the anti-infective and the oncology segment

items.statement: Middle East tender timing uncertain; LPG/furnace oil cost pressure offsets ~50% of solar savings
items.quote: the fuel is something that is on the higher side. And I think if that improves, then we should get closer to the 1.5% EBITDA mark

items.statement: Capacity sufficient for INR 3,000 cr revenue; next major capex >INR 100 cr in 4-5 years
items.quote: manufacturing capacities across all 4 units supporting a peak revenue potential of approximately INR 3,000 crores

items.statement: Zero debt; cash INR 414 cr; CFO/EBITDA 73%; working capital to normalize in H1 FY27
items.quote: We are a zero-debt company with cash and cash equivalent of more than around INR 414 crores as on 31st March 2026.

items.statement: Expect ~15% top-line growth in FY27 vs FY26 with profitability normalizing to ~20% EBITDA margin
items.quote: We think that conservatively we should deliver about 15% higher top line as compared to current year.

items.statement: Target 30-40% growth in domestic packaging business in FY27
items.quote: Barring U.S. disruption, our stated packaging growth momentum of 30-40% remains intact, which is what we are even targeting in FY27.

items.statement: Of Rs 89 cr order book, Rs 9 cr (9-layer co-extrusion) for H2FY27, rest Rs 80 cr for H1FY27
items.quote: Out of the order book of 89 crores, there is one 9 crore order for 9-layer co-extrusion line. That will be basically H2FY27. The rest of 80 crores is for H1FY27.

items.statement: Export gross margin ~60%, domestic gross margin ~42-43%
items.quote: our margin from export is about 60%. And in domestic, it is about 42-43%.

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margin to normalize to ~20% as one-off costs roll off and top line recovers
items.quote: We expect profitability to normalize to historical averages of around 20% as the top line recovers and these one-off costs roll off.

items.statement: Majority of input cost increases passed on to customers; custom-built solutions allow project-level pass-through
items.quote: We have taken stock of the situation. We have done a study of what our competitors are doing. We have done a risk analysis and then to maximum possible extent, we have passed on the increase in cost to end customers already.

items.statement: US business declined ~50% in FY26 (incl. Canada, Mexico); expect recovery in FY27 as tariff concerns ease
items.quote: During FY26, our U.S. business declined by close to 50 percent in absolute terms.

items.statement: Two 9-layer co-extrusion machines delivered in FY26; one more scheduled for H2FY27
items.quote: Two machines have been executed in FY26, and one machine will get executed in H2FY27.

items.statement: West Asia crisis delayed shipment of 3 machines (~Rs 3.5 cr) to Saudi Arabia in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Specifically, we have three machines that are on our shop floor ready. They were to be shipped in the month of late February, early March to Saudi Arabia, and we have not been able to ship them because of the crisis in the Middle East. Approximate value is about three and a half crores.

items.statement: Remained debt-free with Rs 69.26 cr cash on hand at FY26 end; funding R&D and expansion internally
items.quote: Even by the end of FY26, we have remained debt free. We have maintained our cash on hand at 69.26 crores by FY26 and this is our war chest that allows us to do risk mitigation as well as internal approvals for any expansion.

items.statement: Targeting 20-25% revenue growth for FY27
items.quote: Sir, we expect around a 20% to 25% growth rate, trying to maintain that.

items.statement: Targeting EBITDA margin of 10-11% for FY27
items.quote: So basically if we say so instead of 9% our target is 10% to 11% target for the current year.

items.statement: Order book of INR 1,235 crore as of March 31, 2026
items.quote: As of March 31, 2026, the company reported a healthy order book of approximately INR1,235 crores.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin improved 105 bps to 9.13%
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved by 105 basis points to 9.13%, reflecting better operating leverage, improved project mix, procurement efficiencies, and stronger execution across projects.

items.statement: Wastewater segment EBITDA margin 15-20%
items.quote: Yes. It is near about the 15% to 20% of EBITDA margin.

items.statement: No slowdown in tender pipeline; bidding for larger scale projects
items.quote: No, sir, there is no slowdown in the tender process. Actually, why do you see a decrease in that is the reason that we are now bidding for a higher scale of projects.

items.statement: Target revenue mix: 40% EPC roads/buildings, 20-25% wastewater, 35-40% toll collection
items.quote: So, we are trying to stay around 40% in EPC road and building from revenue. In wastewater, near about 20% to 25% for wastewater and remaining 35% to 40% in toll collection contracts.

items.statement: Enhancement of borrowing limits approved to support larger project opportunities
items.quote: Additionally, the Board has proposed enhancement of borrowing limits to support larger project opportunities and long-term expansion plans.

items.statement: Acquired 10% stake in Virtuoso Infra Meditech LLP for INR 150 crore real estate project in Indore
items.quote: The company is going to have an estimated revenue of near about INR150 crores for the overall construction and sale of the said building.

items.statement: Board recommended maiden dividend of 0.25% per share (2.5% of face value)
items.quote: The Board has recommended a maiden dividend of 0.25% per share, equivalent to 2.5% of the face value of INR10 per share.

items.statement: Record order book of INR 1,143 crores as of March 2026 with INR 591.3 crores EPC balance and INR 526.1 crores Tollway balance value
items.quote: We closed this year with a record order book of INR 1,143 crores, which provides strong execution visibility ahead.

items.statement: Wayside amenities break-even targeted at 5-8 years in 30-year contracts and 3-7 years in 20-year contracts; balance sheet can support capex
items.quote: we are looking in the ballpark of 5 to 8 years in a 30-year time period, and let's say 3 to 5 years, maybe 7 years in a 20-year period.

items.statement: EPC margins 13-14%, Toll segment 7%, Real Estate ~50%; focus on improving Toll margins through technology and leakage reduction
items.quote: EPC margins are 13% to 14%, Toll segment is 7%, and in Real Estate, we work at approximately 50% margins.

items.statement: Government allocated INR 3.1 lakh crores to MoRTH for FY27; 501 wayside amenities awarded, 94 operational, 700+ expected by FY29
items.quote: The government has allocated INR 3.1 lakh crores to the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways for FY27.

items.statement: Actively bidding for wayside amenities on controlled access corridors and EV charging infrastructure; commissioned 2 EV projects in Indore
items.quote: We have been actively bidding for some, and in the near future, you will be seeing the visibility for that.

items.statement: MLFF tolling viewed as positive long-term; reduces operator risk, longer tenure, PPP model favors organized players; near-term impact limited
items.quote: we don't have to mitigate this because we don't see this as an issue. We see this on the positive side that we have much less risk, much longer tenure

items.statement: Selective bidding with minimum 13-14% gross profit threshold in EPC; walked away from Venkatapalam (INR 26.33 lakh penalty) and Katiyara Fee Plaza
items.quote: we will not go below a GP of let's say 13% to 14% as opposed to the industry where people might go below 10% also.

items.statement: Insurance revenue expected to reach 15-20% of total business revenue by FY28
items.quote: And we see insurance revenue to go in the same line, which will like pick up the traction in FY 28, and it can be roughly around 15% to 20% of our total business revenue.

items.statement: Plan inorganic expansion outside Gujarat within next few months, funded from cash/bond inventory
items.quote: Fourth or fifth, we are targeting some type of inorganic growth or acquisition, which will be definitely outside of the Gujarat. At the right time, we'll announce it.

items.statement: Infrastructure expansion planned for Q3 FY27 using capital released from trading book wind-down
items.quote: And part of that will also utilize for infrastructure expansion. That will be also in the Q3 of FY 27.

items.statement: Net equity inflows of ARR assets were INR386 crores in FY26 despite negative equity markets
items.quote: Our net equity inflows of ARR assets remained positive at INR386 crores during FY26.

items.statement: Cost-to-income ratio (excl. one-time items) was 29.9% in FY26 vs 23% in FY25 due to strategic investments
items.quote: Our cost-to-income ratio, excluding exceptional loss of INR1.5 crores in FY25 and AMC-related costs of INR2.3 crores in FY26, stood at 29.9% in FY26 as compared to 23% in FY25.

items.statement: Total client families grew 5% YoY to 6,889; overall client base grew 5% to 21,746 in FY26
items.quote: Total client families increased 5% year-on-year to 6,889 as of March of 2026, with the addition of 311 new client families during the year. Overall client base also grew 5% to 21,746 clients

items.statement: Guided for 20-25% revenue growth in FY27, citing INR22 crore spillover and INR30+ crore orders by end-May as confidence drivers
items.quote: our confidence of projecting for this current FY27 is because we already started our year with INR22 crores as a spillover and by end of 30th May, we already have INR30-plus crores in hand

items.statement: Order book stands at INR31 crores as of FY26 end, with INR22 crore spillover into FY27 and target of INR100+ crore orders by September
items.quote: We have also shown a good order book of INR31 crores this financial year

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved 152 bps to 19.6% in FY26 due to software value additions and product mix change; PAT margin up 250 bps to 13.3%
items.quote: EBITDA margin also improved from 18.1% to 19.6%, which is 152 bps and then PAT grew from INR7.79 crores to INR10.43 crores which is 33.8% year-on-year growth and this is a cascading effect of the impact of EBITDA growth

items.statement: Project UDAN manufacturing facility to be operational by mid-2028, targeting INR11-13 crore revenue in FY29, INR28-30 crore in FY30, INR57-61 crore in FY31
items.quote: we are anticipating somewhere in the range of INR11 crores to INR13 crores in FY29, and then INR28 crores to INR30 crores in FY30, and INR57 crores to INR61 crores in FY31

items.quote: in measurement equipments what it's majority of the software value add that happens, wherein not a lot of material cost goes into it. So, that's the reason why we were able to attain much better margins

items.quote: though we had orders in hand, back-to-back orders have been placed, generally the systems which take to get landed and reaching our office takes something like 8 weeks, that is 2 months, it really went on more than double, almost it took almost 4 months

items.statement: Tender pipeline of INR200+ crore remains intact but delayed 6-8 months due to government fund reallocation; INR100+ crore orders expected by September with budget allocated and tenders submitted
items.quote: Only thing is because of the fund allocation whatever is happening by Government of India, priorities have changed. Because priorities have changed, allocation of fund coming to the particular labs, they got readjusted

items.statement: Incorporated subsidiary Abhedhya for RF systems (radar/EW/comms) to address capability gaps; separate entity due to different talent, infrastructure, and cost structure vs TMS business
items.quote: the kind of people who are going to work on that, the kind of infrastructure which is required on that, the quality of the expertise, both when it comes to design expertise which is required under that heading is going to be totally different

items.statement: Developing indigenous single-board computer (SBC) under R&D for mil-grade -20 to +85°C operation; functional demo underway, environmental testing next, targeting deployment in TMS and radar systems
items.quote: We are going to build everything from the scratch, starting from PCB, starting from the component, the kind of design what we are going to do, everything has to be as per mil-grade systems

items.statement: Raised INR81 crores via BSE SME listing in January 2026; debt-to-equity improved from 0.4x to 0.04x; operating cash flow turned positive INR12.63 crores in FY26
items.quote: in January 2026, we were successful in raising around INR81 crores fund and got listed ourselves on BSE SME

items.statement: Current capacity can support INR150-160 crore revenue; Project UDAN needed for next growth phase beyond that
items.quote: with the current setup, we anticipate it can go anywhere up to about INR150 crores, INR160 crores with the current setup, with the current facilities that we have

items.statement: Finance cost capitalized for guest house construction (INR2.1 crore exposure) at REPO + 2.5% cost of capital; rest charged to P&L
items.quote: The cost of capital is REPO Plus 2.5

items.statement: Export strategy via OEM tie-ups (Sperry, Eirad) to access Tier-1 supply chains (Airbus, Boeing); MOUs signed, in evaluation phase
items.quote: we have a couple of tie-ups with OEMs and yes, foreign companies such as Sperry and Eirad. So, we are in discussion and evaluation with these companies to help us reach the Tier-1 companies like Airbus and Boeing

items.statement: Revenue 100% B2G (direct or via PSUs like BDL/BEL); no B2C; concentration risk mitigated by DCPP nomination-based production contracts
items.quote: if I have to answer your question, it is 100% B2G. It's just that the routing could be in a different fashion

items.statement: Management targets ZBM rollout to 75-80% of COCO network (800-850 stores) by end of Q1 FY27
items.quote: our plan is to take it to almost 75% to 80% of the network by this quarter end

items.statement: Employee cost structurally lower by ~10% YoY due to plant closure and VRS
items.quote: our employee cost is lower by about 10%. And this benefit is flowing from -- to the employee cost line item on a structural basis

items.statement: E-commerce channel (B2B, B2C, dot-com) remains fastest-growing; 700+ stores now fulfilling online orders
items.quote: The e-commerce business continues to be our fastest-growing channel. It continues to grow across its business lines of B2B, B2C as well as dot-com

items.statement: Blended raw material inflation currently 5-6%; no price hike rolled out yet but monitoring dynamically
items.quote: the last quoted number that I had in the review was in the range of about 5% to 6%. So that will have to be covered for

items.statement: Minimum wage hikes in 3-4 states structural but partially insulated as many locations already pay above minimum
items.quote: those are more structural, and I guess will be perennial. In many places, we were already paying more than minimum wage

items.statement: March better than January showing intra-quarter acceleration; no tangible change in consumer sentiment yet
items.quote: March was better than Jan. So, we did see acceleration of momentum, not only quarter 4 versus quarter 3, but within the quarter

items.statement: Premium portfolio (Hush Puppies, Power) outpacing growth; Hush Puppies ~18-20% of turnover and fastest-growing brand
items.quote: Hush Puppies will continue at a significant acceleration. It is our fastest-growing brand and will continue to be

items.statement: Marketing spend elevated at ~1.5x; 80-85% digital marketing; sneaker proposition for younger consumers in progress
items.quote: the broad ratio would be digital is almost lion's share, almost 80%, 85% of our marketing spend

items.statement: Company expects to perform better in FY27 than FY26 driven by improved utilization of recently commissioned capacities, product mix optimization, and additional capacities coming online during FY27.
items.quote: The company expects to perform better in FY27 than FY26, driven by improved utilization of recently commissioned capacities, product mix optimization and additional capacities expected to come online during FY27.

items.statement: Expects Rs 1,900-2,000 crore of CWIP to be capitalized in FY27; key projects include Egypt aseptic (12bn packs), Mexico WPP, India PCR PET & MLP, and Dharwad BOPP line (54,000 MTPA) commissioning FY27-28.
items.quote: Roughly, we expect around Rs. 1,900 crore to Rs. 2,000 crore as a number, which will be capitalized.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin expanded to 15.3% (highest in 14 quarters); FY26 full-year margin 12.8% (+70 bps YoY). Management expects FY27 margin between FY26 full-year (12.8%) and Q4 level (15.3%), noting film spreads have moderated in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: Anything between that and the last quarter is what we would look at.

items.statement: International revenue contribution increased to 57% (vs 43% domestic) in Q4 FY26, up from corresponding quarter last year. Packaging Solutions EBITDA contribution ~40% in FY26, expected to rise in FY27 with new aseptic, WPP, recycling capac
items.quote: Currently, as we speak, it is 57% contribution from international revenue and 43% from India revenue. And that, in fact, if you compare with the corresponding quarter last year, has shown a transition towards higher contribution of international business.

items.statement: Blended cost of debt ~9% (Rs 777 cr finance cost on Rs 8,500 cr debt). Expect cost of funds to improve as international revenue share rises (overseas funding cheaper). No refinancing initiated yet; open to opportunities.
items.quote: Overall, our blended cost of funds is about 9%. If you see the Rs.777 crore against the total outstanding of Rs 8,500 crore, you will see this more or less in the range of close to about 9%.

items.statement: Capex cycle largely focused on value-accretive, higher-margin projects (aseptic, WPP, recycling). Management remains open to further capex where market opportunity and margin expansion exist; Dharwad BOPP line (Rs ~700 cr) major part in FY2
items.quote: We will remain open globally to the opportunities where we feel there is a good market, there is a clear market and expansion of margins. And that capex, we are not saying no to.

items.statement: Packaging Solutions EBITDA contribution ~40% in FY26 (vs 60% films); expected to increase in FY27 as new aseptic, WPP, recycling capacities ramp up. Packaging Solutions revenue share 36% in FY26.
items.quote: When it comes to EBITDA, largely, I think it is in the range of close to about 40% contribution from the Packaging Solutions business and about 60% from the packaging films business.

items.statement: India packaging film volumes declined 6.3% YoY in Q4 FY26 due to softer FMCG demand (0.9% growth) and customers deferring purchases amid raw material cost increases and price correction expectations.
items.quote: Sales volume declined 6.3% YoY, impacted by softer FMCG demand with volume growth moderating to 0.9% in Q4FY26 as higher raw material costs and supply disruptions led customers to defer purchases amid general expectations of price correction and lower inventory losses.

items.statement: Targets 20%+ revenue CAGR over next three years including FY27; aims for >Rs100 cr PAT in FY27; aspires to double FY26 sales by FY29 within current capacity
items.quote: we remain confident of sustaining our strong growth momentum, maintaining stable margins and delivering healthy long -term growth, with an estimated CAGR of around 20% over the next three years and particularly for FY27

items.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin expected at 25-26% long-term, below recent 28-30% levels
items.quote: I would advise investors to consider 25 –26% as the more realistic and sustainable EBITDA margin

items.statement: Order book as of April 1 stands at Rs130-135 cr with typical 110-120 day cycle
items.quote: Generally, in our company, the cycle is typically around 1 10 to 120 days, and in terms of value, it stands at approximately INR 130–135 crores

items.statement: Raw material costs up ~10% from March 1; sales price impact ~4-5%; partial compensation from April 1, remainder from July 1; rupee depreciation and >60% export share provide offset
items.quote: Raw material costs have gone up by approximately 10% across the board, and the impact on sales prices is expected to be around 4 –5%

items.statement: Export segment outperforming domestic; >60% revenue from exports; strong traction from North America and global OEMs via China+1 diversification; new part development accelerating last 4-6 weeks
items.quote: During the year, exports contributed over 60% of revenues, reaffirming our str ong global positioning, while we continued to witness steady traction from North America and other developed markets alongside increased engagement with global OEMs driven by ongoing supply chain diversification

items.statement: Ground engaging tools contribution to rise from 1.1% of FY26 sales to 3.8% in FY27 from existing customers
items.quote: In FY26, the ground engaging tools contribution in total sales was 1.1% in the next financial year FY27, we plan to go up to 3.8%

items.statement: Defense prototype approved for compact vehicle parts; potential Rs15-18 cr sales if serial orders materialize in next 1-2 quarters
items.quote: if everything goes well, we could have sales for this segment in the region o f INR15 crores to INR18 crores

items.statement: 2.4 MW hybrid power project under commissioning by June 2026; expected annual savings ~Rs3.6 cr
items.quote: our 2.4 MW hybrid power project, which is under commissioning by June 2026 and is likely to improve sustainability while generating annual savings of approximately ~ ₹3.6 crore

items.statement: Railroad segment challenges unresolved; competitive intensity higher; focusing on mining, earthmoving, construction, locomotives instead
items.quote: We did face some challenges in the railroad developments we have been working on, and we have not yet been able to fully resolve them

items.statement: Middle East war impacting crude prices, inflation, trade, energy security; company managing disruptions successfully so far
items.quote: The Middle East war has significantly impacted various industries in India, particularly those t hat rely heavily on imported crude oil and gas

items.statement: Debt-free balance sheet with ~Rs114 cr cash reserves providing flexibility
items.quote: we continue to maintain strong financial prudence, with a debt-free balance sheet and healthy cash reserves of around ₹114 crores

items.statement: Will implement detailed sector-wise and geography-wise revenue breakup in presentations from Q1 FY27
items.quote: Sir, your suggestion well taken, and we will try and implement this from first quarter of FY27

items.statement: FY27 volume guidance of 105-110 million meters vs 94 million in FY26
items.quote: We expect volumes to be in the range of 105 million to 110 million meters compared to 94 million meters achieved in FY26.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue target of ~INR5,500 crores implying >30% growth
items.quote: On the revenue front, we are targeting consolidated revenues of approximately INR5,500 crores, implying revenue growth of over 30% in FY27 compared to FY26.

items.statement: Non-U.S. core revenues expected to grow 20% in FY27
items.quote: we expect stronger traction from these markets going forward and anticipate non-U.S. revenues to grow by 20% in FY27.

items.statement: Planned capex of INR250 crores over next 12-18 months funded 75% internal accruals, 25% debt
items.quote: We have planned capex outlay of INR250 crores to be completed in the next 12 to 18 months, and this will be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt.

items.statement: New business at run rate of ~INR1,100 crores; Q4 FY26 at INR270 crores
items.quote: We've been very transparent, and we are already at a run rate of almost INR1,100 crores as we speak. In our Q4, we've done INR270-odd crores.

items.statement: Core business EBITDA margin expected ~15%; new business turning EBITDA positive in FY27
items.quote: So from our core business, we expect to do around 15%. And as we are ramping up our new business, then our target is to get to overall 15% levels, if not higher.

items.statement: Raw material costs (cotton, yarn, energy, chemicals) all up; expect to pass through within a quarter
items.quote: So, Raman, normally, it would -- I mean, of course, in a scenario like now, I mean, because people would act very quickly because this is not a normal scenario. So, it should take us within a quarter, we should be able to pass them on.

items.statement: U.S. demand normalized; retailers raised prices, consumers accepted; no restocking
items.quote: In the U.S., it's interesting. Despite the inflationary pressure, we have not observed any material impact on the demand scenario. In fact, with the U.S. tariff overhang settling down, we believe that the trade environment is improving in FY27.

items.statement: Utility bedding 2/3 of new business, brands 1/3; utility bedding target 15% margin, brands 16-17%
items.quote: It's 2/3, 1/3. 2/3 is coming from utility bedding of the new business and 1/3 is coming from brands.

items.statement: Long-term debt repayment INR85-90 crores/year for next couple of years
items.quote: As far as the debt is concerned, we have a long-term debt repayment of around between INR85 crores to INR90 crores every year right now for the next couple of years.

items.statement: Tax rate assumed at 25% going forward
items.quote: 25% is the tax rate. So, you should assume that...

items.statement: Working capital days stable at 121 days; expected to remain similar with revenue growth
items.quote: Our working capital days remained stable at 121 days versus last year of 132 days.

items.statement: Management expects domestic demand momentum to continue in FY27 but cautions fuel price increases and rupee depreciation may impact demand in coming quarters
items.quote: So, we do expect to have a good year for domestic as well.

items.statement: Management is optimistic about export recovery in FY27 if Middle East crisis normalizes, with scaling up in UK, US, Europe, Africa, Southeast Asia
items.quote: Overall, we are fairly optimistic, whether it is the Middle East or outside of the Middle East, I think overall exports, we are fairly optimistic this year for some recovery.

items.statement: Margins currently comfortable as cost increases are being passed through; further margin pressure if cost inflation persists or crisis prolongs
items.quote: I do not think there is any serious pressure right now on the margin front because we are passing through increases as they come.

items.statement: FY27 capex planned around INR 100 crore, similar to last year, focused on flexible packaging capacity expansion; calibrated approach due to uncertainty
items.quote: Yes, that would be about similar to last year, about INR 100-odd crore, I think, is the expectation.

items.statement: Flexible packaging revenue share ~20% in FY26, slightly up from prior year; folding carton >50% of business; no specific mix shift target, aim for double-digit growth in each segment
items.quote: Flexible is about 20%.

items.statement: Middle East crisis creates high uncertainty for exports; paper prices (virgin and recycled board) still rising steadily, making cost pass-through difficult
items.quote: The situation is highly uncertain and very difficult to have any outlook as such.

items.statement: Chennai greenfield facility >50% utilized with positive outlook and new customer approvals; Noida plant also improving steadily
items.quote: We have more than 50% utilized now and the outlook is quite positive.

items.statement: Recyclable films production up driven by export demand; domestic adoption limited due to lack of government mandate and upcharge
items.quote: Our production of recyclable films is up because we use it in export jobs.

items.statement: Paper prices (virgin board big increase, recycled board steady drip) still rising; MIP on imports expiring soon, domestic mills under cost pressure, further increases likely
items.quote: Particularly on the virgin board side, there is a big increase and even on the recycled board price, there is a steady drip of price increases happening.

items.statement: New flexible packaging line (4th at unit) expected to commercialize by end of FY27; temporary profitability pressure during absorption, then operating leverage improvement
items.quote: Once the new capacity comes on stream, there will naturally be some temporary pressure on profitability as the capex gets absorbed.

items.statement: Net debt INR 554.7 crore at FY26 end; Net Debt/Equity 0.77x, Net Debt/EBITDA 1.75x; ECB mark-to-market loss INR 18 crore non-cash
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, Net Debt stood at INR 554.7 crore at the end of FY26, while leverage metrics remain comfortable, with Net Debt-to-Equity at 0.77x and Net Debt-to-EBITDA at 1.75x.

items.statement: Board recommended dividend INR 25/share for FY26, 26th consecutive year of uninterrupted payouts
items.quote: The Board has recommended a dividend of INR 25 per share for FY26. This marks our 26th consecutive year of uninterrupted dividend payouts.

items.statement: FY27 Guinea revenue expected at least $700 million at ~$70/ton pricing
items.quote: whatever number you pick, and you can even considering today's price approx $70, at least $700 million from Guinea should come

items.statement: India business capex ~INR150 crores over next year for plant upgrades and new products
items.quote: We are, therefore, looking at a significant capex over the next year, roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions, to upgrade our plant facilities and add new products to our portfolio.

items.statement: Iron ore and bauxite beneficiation capex to be handled via BOT/partner models, not on balance sheet
items.quote: we are currently evaluating models wherein the capex can be handled by our potential vendors or partners, and we are looking at perhaps a build-operate-transfer kind of a model. Nothing is finalized yet, but we are definitely currently more not focused on adding capex to our balance sheet as far as these projects are c

items.statement: Bauxite CIF China index rose from ~$60 to ~$68-69/ton, driven almost entirely by freight increase, not ore price
items.quote: if you see the index which we are tracking, that is a CIF to China. So, the increase from 60 to approx 68 or 69 around that part is basically almost entirely due to the increase in freight on that particular route.

items.statement: Net bauxite prices (ex-freight) expected to improve significantly after Guinea quota system implementation
items.quote: We expect significant relief on the net bauxite prices, by net bauxite I mean bauxite minus freight, post the quota system.

items.statement: Guinea quota system expected within month; may cut 20-25% of large-player volumes, benefiting smaller miners like Ashapura
items.quote: I personally feel that it's going to impact to the extent of about 20% to 25%, you know, the reduction in the volume, and that that will be mostly three or four large players, they will lose that volumes and that will be added into volume of the three to four small players.

items.statement: No income tax liability in Guinea for at least 1-2 years; only negligible MAT in India
items.quote: for at least, I can say, the next one or two years, there won't be any tax liability at least to Ashapura.

items.statement: Acquisition of TAO Digital valued at $218M with $130M upfront (60%) and 2-year earnouts; primarily debt-funded
items.quote: As you know, that 100% of the earnout payouts which are linked to the performance, the deal is valued at $218 million. Now the upfront is 60% roughly of this value, about $130 million

items.statement: Upfront payment at 7.9x CY2025 EBITDA; all-cash deal, EPS accretive and ROCE positive after integration
items.quote: which works out to 7.9x the CY 2025 EBITDA of the target. Now this is to be paid at closing with 100% transfer of shares

items.statement: TAO Digital current EBITDA margin ~20%; modeled at lower margin for CY27 due to integration costs
items.quote: Then the EBITDA margins are closer to actually 20% for the company. We have taken some haircut number at 2 years from a modeling perspective

items.statement: TAO Digital growing at >100% CAGR organically; conservative growth assumptions used for modeling
items.quote: The past 3 years growth is very high for organic as well. What we have considered going forward is actually conservative in that sense from compared to their historical perspective

items.statement: Technology revenue mix to shift from high single digits to high teens with TAO acquisition
items.quote: from around high single-digit areas, we are adding more than 10 bps in terms of the mix of service line, which is in the technology area for us. So from high single digits, we are going to high teens

items.statement: Acquisition primarily funded through debt; debt serviced by TAO's free cash flow
items.quote: The acquisition will be primarily funded through debt. We use a combination of debt and equity, but primarily it will be funded by debt

items.statement: Strong demand signals for AI-driven data engineering and platform engineering across industrial sectors
items.quote: The data, getting the data ready for AI and collecting as much data as we can is the low-hanging opportunity in the market, which has a 2-3 year runway for us

items.statement: Management retention secured via 2-year earnout; intent for key personnel to continue beyond earnout period
items.quote: there's a 2-year earnout, and it is substantially incentivizing the management team for that 2-year earnout. So that is a clear lock in which is there

items.statement: Non-recurring M&A charges expected this quarter from TAO deal; other acquisitions in early evaluation stages
items.quote: There are some in the pipeline. But for now, I think we will have a nonrecurring charge this quarter as well coming in from this transaction

items.statement: Data digitization business (20% of revenue) has lower billing rates but enables high-value downstream data engineering work
items.quote: And within offshore, about 40% of the workforce is also data digitization work, particularly for the overall deliverable. But that business is about 20% of the overall business

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue growth expected at 20-25% YoY; EBITDA margin target 20-25%
items.quote: We definitely are looking at 20%, 25%. I don't want to promise 30% to 35%, we will definitely try for the highest possible, but can't say at this point.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 20-25%; FY28 blended EBITDA margin expected 30%+
items.quote: I think we should achieve between 20% to 25% going forward. Like I said, once the izmoMicro revenue kicks in and the costs are flattish, you'll start seeing the margin accretion happening at the EBITDA as well as net profit level.

items.statement: Planning INR125 cr capex in FY27 for izmoMicro expansion; new facility operational by Q2-Q3 FY28
items.quote: We are raising around INR150 crores mostly for capex. So I think around INR 125 crores will be capex and INR25 crores will be working capital.

items.statement: izmoMicro order book INR40 cr with INR100 cr pipeline; current orders take 9 months to execute
items.quote: We have around INR40 crores for izmoMicro and the pipeline is around INR100 crores. That means not yet closed, but at various stages of discussion with the customers.

items.statement: izmoMicro FY27 revenue expected INR45-50 cr (vs INR18-19 cr FY26); 80% advanced packaging, 20% silicon photonics
items.quote: We are expecting around INR50 crores this year in FY27 from Izmomicro, specifically. I would say between INR45 crores to INR50 crores.

items.statement: Strong demand from defense, space, telecom, AI hyperscalers across India, US, Europe; no slowdown foreseen
items.quote: Izmomicro's order pipeline from defense, space, telecom and AI hyperscaler customers is healthy and we foresee no slowdown in demand.

items.statement: izmoMicro 5-year revenue target INR1,200-1,500 cr; new plant capacity INR1,200 cr top line at full utilization
items.quote: After 5 years, I think INR1,200 cores to INR1,500 crores.

items.statement: New facility implementation by mid-FY28; revenue ramp from Q3 FY28; phased utilization 20% -> 60% -> 80-90%
items.quote: We will expect to implement the project by next -- middle of next year. So from of Q2 of FY27, '28, you start seeing -- Q3, you'll start seeing the revenue flowing in.

items.statement: izmoMicro packaging gross margins 50-60%; silicon photonics packaging margins 80%+ of chip cost; blended EBITDA 35%+ at scale
items.quote: That should be around 35% plus.

items.statement: FrogData revenue resurgence in Q4 FY26 after 2 flat quarters; strong pipeline; 93%+ gross revenue retention
items.quote: We are getting good business from the last quarter onwards. It was flat in between for 2 quarters, and the market was a bit sluggish, but we are seeing again a resurgence in the last quarter and very strong order pipeline going forward.

items.statement: Expects 5,000 tenancies (approx 4,000 towers) from Vodafone in FY27, with bulk order expected by June end
items.quote: We are expecting around 5,000 towers from Vodafone in current financial year to be deployed. And a big bulk order is on way and should reach us by June end, most likely, we will be able to get a big chunk of business from Vodafone by June end.

items.statement: Revenue per tower expected to sustain between INR31,000-32,000 in FY27
items.quote: Similar numbers. The revenue per tower would remain between INR31,000 to INR32,000.

items.statement: Capex per tower estimated at INR12-15 lakh for 40m GBT towers; total FY27 capex ~INR600 cr for 5,000 towers
items.quote: CapEx per tower will be INR12 lakhs. And in terms of rollout, we are seeing major rollout, Q2 should be around, maximum rollout will come on Q3 and Q4.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin 74%, PAT margin ~30%; gross margin per tower 85%
items.quote: We have locked the revenue from operations to INR221 crore with EBITDA of INR1,642 million, which is another -- and again, we have sustained EBITDA margin or we have improved on EBITDA margin with 74% EBITDA.

items.statement: BSNL orders uncertain until Tejas network issues resolved (backhaul instability, SIM latching problems); no confirmed timeline
items.quote: BSNL networks are not getting stable. There are some SIM related issues where second type of SIM is not able to be latched on to the network. And there are also some micro connectivity issues where their backhauling is not getting stable.

items.statement: 50% of FY27 capex from internal accruals/existing debt; balance 50% to be finalized after Vodafone order confirmation; decision by Q1 FY27
items.quote: Around 50% we'll be able to do from internal accruals plus existing debt limit and everything. For balance, 50% will work out. As and when we get the final numbers from Vodafone, we freeze our actual CapEx amount, that time we'll work out the other balance.

items.statement: Exit tenancies target FY27: 12,000-13,000 (7,000 current + 5,000 Vodafone); BSNL could increase target if issues resolved
items.quote: So, as of now, we feel it should be somewhere around 12,000 to 13,000. 7000 tenancies and 5000, but probably everything is subject to Vodafone rollout.

items.statement: Landlord rent reimbursed by operators: metro RTT sites ~INR20,000/month, rural GBT ~INR7,000-10,000/month; upgrade revenue INR3,000-4,000 per additional technology
items.quote: Almost if you see, metro city we have, where there are more or less RTT sites, we have a rental of around INR20,000 per month to landlord. And for ground-based towers in rural area, it will be INR7,000 to INR10,000 per month. And entire thing is reimbursed by the operator.

items.statement: Interest costs rising due to Ind AS 116 ROU liabilities (not actual debt); actual loan interest ~9%
items.quote: The interest borne on our loans is more or less around 9%. The liabilities increased because of ROU due to Ind AS 116, on that basis, the ROU interest costs are also included under this.

items.statement: Closing order book as of 31 March 2026 stands at INR 876 crores, with new orders of INR 62 crores booked in Q4 FY26 (excluding mobility and product services).
items.quote: During the quarter, we booked our new orders aggregating to INR 62 crores, including mobility -- excluding mobility and product services, taking our closing order book as on 31st March 2026 to a healthy number of INR876 crores.

items.statement: Management expects order inflow in Q2 FY27 to match or exceed full-year FY26 order intake (~INR 350 crores), and surpass it by Q3 FY27.
items.quote: We will be able to match what FY 26 will close by Q2. And then we'll be able to surpass what we achieved in FY 26 by Q3.

items.statement: VTS subsidiary revenue expected to more than double to over INR 20 crores in FY27 with positive EBITDA, up from INR 7-8 crores in FY26.
items.quote: So VTS, we may expect a good revenue jump. In fact, it may be more than 2x or more than 2x from what we have achieved in the FY 25-26 on VTS. So we are expecting VTS to not only contribute a turnover of more than INR 20 crores, but it could be also a profitable growth.

items.statement: Consolidated subsidiaries targeted to reach breakeven in FY27, eliminating the drag on consolidated EBITDA margins.
items.quote: We will be in breakeven in this financial year. We are targeting to have that breakeven in these subsidiaries, but we may also incur certain expenses towards BD in this financial year also.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 327 bps YoY to 21.9% for FY26, driven by higher-value solutions, workforce upskilling (revenue per employee up from INR 24L to 55L), and AI-enabled technology initiatives; management says margin is sustainable.
items.quote: I would bracket it into three reasons. One is that we have improved our delivery capacity. We are, therefore, trying to tap higher value segment rather than going into the lower value segment of data acquisition. We are more into solutions.

items.statement: IP development capex targeted at INR 12-15 crores for FY27 for 3 major IPs, to be expensed as revenue expenditure.
items.quote: In the recent AOP, we have identified at least 3 major IPs where the expenditure outlay is targeted to be in the range of around INR 12 crores to INR 15 crores, but that is also a part of our revenue expenditure.

items.statement: Strong demand across infrastructure, transport, energy, and defense domains; new pipeline focused on highways, metros, ports, and digital twin projects, with Jal Jeevan Mission now <15% of order book.
items.quote: We have usually a different life cycle of project on the BD where you will get one or the other domain picking up and getting because as government funds, government budget comes, accordingly, even the business runs.

items.statement: Technology Solutions revenue declined slightly in Q4 FY26 due to milestone timing, but grew 41% YoY for full year; AI/ML-enabled solutions expected to enhance Technology Solutions turnover in coming quarters.
items.quote: No, no, it is completely temporary. In fact, the overall mix of technology solutions in the contract has been more than 55%, 60%. And as it happens during a particular quarter, maybe I have not achieved a milestone for recognizing the revenue.

items.statement: Key risks include government fund sanctions and milestone delays for receivables >1 year (INR 27 crores); mitigation via domain diversification across infrastructure, energy, transport, defense, and international expansion.
items.quote: So there are challenges, not maybe some are -- because of the milestone, other are because of the government funds and sanctions, which we are waiting, and we are hopeful to get the same in the same financial year 26-27.

items.statement: Preferential issue proceeds (INR 235 crores mobilized) being restructured to include joint ventures alongside acquisitions; postal ballot for special resolution to be circulated.
items.quote: The amount of INR 235 crores, which was mobilized had been earlier earmarked for the particular 70%, 20% and 10% kind of scenario. With the kind of options which we are getting, there may be a slight change in the requirement of the funds.

items.statement: International revenue to grow faster, targeting government business mix to reduce from ~70% to <50% over next 2-3 years while growing both segments.
items.quote: So grow international faster, grow India business at its own pace without taking much exposure or risk and still have a combination of changing the mix from the present of government business from, let's say, average 70% to less than 50% over the next 2 to 3 years, but while continuing to grow.

items.statement: Net cash balance increased to INR 248 crores as of 31 March 2026 from INR 123 crores a year ago; net working capital cycle improved to 157 days from 162 days.
items.quote: We delivered positive cash flow from operations and further strengthened our balance sheet with the overall net cash balance increasing to INR 248 crores as on 31st March 2026 from INR 123 crores a year ago.

items.statement: Acquisition/JV closure expected in next 1-2 quarters; targeting industry leaders in geospatial/engineering domains for capability enhancement and client logos.
items.quote: Based on these opportunities, we find that the new opportunity which we are tapping right now, there could be a closure of inorganic growth for the purpose of due diligence in next 1 or 2 quarters.

items.statement: Tech Mahindra partnership progressing: POCs completed, projects being executed in US telecom domain, expanding to energy and water; both parties committed to partnership growth.
items.quote: We have already done a few POCs. We are doing some projects with them, some POCs in U.S. with them. They won some projects, and they are going to give those projects to us.

items.statement: Target 1-2 percentage points combined ratio improvement year-on-year for FY27
items.quote: Overall target that we have put for ourselves is to improve by 2% or 1% to 2% year-on-year.

items.statement: Expect single-digit premium growth in FY27 due to soft market conditions
items.quote: In terms of growth, you mentioned about single-digit growth, yes, as it could be single-digit growth in the current year.

items.statement: Motor foreign portfolio pruning complete; returning to growth mode in FY27 after 2 years of degrowth
items.quote: We have reached a stage in the year '26, '27, where we need to go back to the growth mode in the international motor side.

items.statement: Holding reserves for pruned international motor business (US, Israel, Turkey); claim reduction slower than premium reduction
items.quote: Yes, we are holding reserves.

items.statement: Solvency ratio improved to 4.21x; capital to be utilized for impending RBC and IFRS implementation
items.quote: Our solvency will be more utilized towards the, like, impending RBC and our IFRS.

items.statement: Dividend payout increased to 13.25% (32.5% higher than previous year)
items.quote: We are giving a dividend payout of 13.25%, which is 32% -- 32.5% more than what we have given earlier.

items.statement: Adjusted combined ratio improved to 84.79% in FY26 from 85.79% in FY25
items.quote: Adjusted combined ratio, factoring in policyholders' investment income stood at 84.79% for the financial year '26 as compared to 85.79% in the previous year.

items.statement: Targeting at least double-digit domestic revenue growth in FY27
items.quote: At least we are targeting a double-digit growth for sure.

items.statement: Expecting major growth in US business in FY27
items.quote: In the US, we have done well last year and we expect a major growth also this year in the US.

items.statement: Monocon targeting breakeven performance by Q4 FY27
items.quote: We remain focused on restoring profitability and are targeting breakeven performance by Q4 FY27.

items.statement: Greenfield project in Khurda, Odisha progressing; Board evaluating pace and structure of future investment
items.quote: Work related to our proposed greenfield project in Khurda, Odisha has picked up. At the same time, the Board continues to evaluate the pace and the structure of the future investment in line with evolving market conditions and strategic priorities.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 7.7% for FY26; standalone EBITDA margin 11.3% for FY26
items.quote: EBITDA margin was 8.6% in Quarter 4 FY26 and 7.7% for FY26.

items.statement: US subsidiary margins reached high-teen levels in FY26
items.quote: More importantly, this growth was accompanied by significant improvement in profitability with margins in our U.S. subsidiary now reaching high-teen levels.

items.statement: Actively engaging customers for price revision to pass through elevated raw material costs
items.quote: We are actively engaging with the customer regarding price revision and discussions are progressing constructively. While this conversations take place, we remain optimistic about achieving a reasonable pass-through of cost increases going forward.

items.statement: Board recommended dividend of Rs 2.15 per share (21.5% of face value) for FY26
items.quote: The Board has recommended a dividend of Rs 2.15per share, equivalent to 21.5% of the face value.

items.statement: Legacy goodwill from 2017 amalgamation fully amortized; FY27 earnings to benefit by ~INR 26.7 crores annually
items.quote: Legacy goodwill arising from 2017 amalgamation has now been fully amortized. As a result from FY27 onwards, our reported earnings will no longer be impacted by annual non-cash legal amortization charge of approximately INR 26.7 crores.

items.statement: Molycop FY27 growth outlook at 3%; FY26 revenue ~1% growth with 12% EBITDA margin
items.quote: the growth outlook, what we are looking for FY '27 is 3% in FY '27 in particular. And of course, this will be refined further once we have a detailed engagement with the management team of Molycop.

items.statement: Order book at INR12,060 million as of March 31, 2026, with INR9,060 million executable within 12 months, up 18% YoY
items.quote: As of March 31, our order book stands at approximately INR12,060 million with INR9,060 million executable within the next 12 months.

items.statement: Tega blended EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 21-22% for FY27 ex-Molycop synergies
items.quote: we have always given a guidance that our blended EBITDA margin will be around 21%, 22%. Yes, of course, this year, it is slightly lower because of the revenue has not been picked up in the consumables segment. So we are still holding this guidance of EBITDA margin at 21%, 22% at a blended level.

items.statement: Logistical disruptions from Middle East disturbances caused vessel/container shortages, increasing finished goods by INR50 crore and delaying Q4 revenue recognition
items.quote: there was quite a significant amount of disruption in the logistical area and which has led to the increase in our FG because material was produced, could not be dispatched because of the availability of the vessel connection and the containers which we have seen in the month of March.

items.statement: Equipment EBITDA margin guided at 12-13% for FY27, similar to FY26 profitability
items.quote: No I think in our guidance, we are talking about 12% to 13% of EBITDA -- and which is basically we will maintain the similar kind of profitability what we did in FY '26.

items.statement: Additional Molycop acquisition costs of ~$30M expected in Q1 FY27 for debt refinancing and preference costs, higher than H2 FY26's INR775M
items.quote: we anticipate a higher number in Q1, which will be the final payoff. We don't get it extended to the rest of the year. So of course, in case if you're looking for a number, it will be close to $30 million of acquisition costs, which we'll have to pay in Q1.

items.statement: Targeting Rs 1,000 crore revenue milestone in FY27
items.quote: we are on track to doing it. We are entering bigger and larger project size. And since we get of that AI infrastructure pie, we are trying to contribute and collaborate in multiple technologies and multiple larger projects.

items.statement: Aim to grow services revenue from 20% to 25% of total in medium term
items.quote: Our aspiration is to take from that 20% to 25% in years to come, in a couple of years to come, in the medium term as you asked.

items.statement: Building complete AI infrastructure solution bouquet including compute, storage, power, cooling, rack and stack
items.quote: we are trying to cover 360 degrees of what an AI-ready company or AI data center or AI infrastructure may need. But mainly, the components are high-speed, reliable networking, a cloud adoption, a cybersecurity solution. And what we were missing in terms of the compute and the compute storage, and second was power cooli

items.statement: UAE subsidiary operational with Etihad Aviation partnership; Sangfor Middle East engagement slowed by geopolitical situation
items.quote: Our UAE subsidiary has become operational and achieved a global local content partner status with Etihad Aviation Group.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improvement trajectory to continue; no specific numeric target given
items.quote: what we have been bettering over the last few years, we will try and continue that same journey or put our efforts that the same journey continues over the next couple of years.

items.statement: Revenue mix shifting from networking (30%) toward security (27%) and UCC (36%); targeting 30-30-30 balance
items.quote: So, this is the trend which we'd like to contribute to where our security and services portion is something which we are keen on growing in the pie. So, we have an equal portion of maybe 30-30-30 and something odd of that ratio.

items.statement: Samsung vendor concentration ~Rs 150-175 crore; managed via exclusive partnership and in-house service capability
items.quote: Overall, our exposure to Samsung, it should be approximately, not exact figures, but around Rs 150-175 crores.

items.statement: Middle East geopolitical situation slowing Sangfor order conversion despite signed partnership
items.quote: From February onwards, the situation out there has changed. So, there are a lot of engagement which has happened, but accumulating that to order and that has become on a slow track.

items.statement: NETSCOUT/Arbor partnership drives 60-70% of their India business; strong DDoS and performance management traction
items.quote: For NETSCOUT and Arbor, we are the most preferred partner in this geography. Approximately 60 to 70% business is driven by DC Infotech of whatever they do.

items.statement: Channel ecosystem expanded to 2,000+ touchpoints across India with 13-14 operational locations
items.quote: Our channel ecosystem has expanded to more than 2,000 touchpoints across India, enabling rapid scaling of new technologies nationwide.

items.statement: FY26 revenue Rs 736.97 crore (+32.6% YoY), PAT Rs 21.21 crore (+46.3% YoY)
items.quote: Revenue for FY26 stood at Rs. 736.97 crores, representing a growth of 32.6% year-on-year. Our PAT stood at Rs. 21.21 crores, growing 46.3% year-on-year.

items.statement: Management targets consolidated revenue of INR5 billion and PAT margin of 11-12% for FY27, with mid-teens PAT growth longer term.
items.quote: our objective is to reach then 5 billion in revenue and 11% to 12% in PAT margins for FY27 and longer-term growth in PAT should be in the mid-teens is what we expect

items.statement: Core business revenue growth targeted at mid-teens percentage for FY27.
items.quote: we are working towards a mid-teen kind of growth rates in revenue

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin improved to 15% in Q4 FY26 from 13.6% in Q3 FY26 due to cost reduction measures.
items.quote: The standalone EBITDA margins for the quarter continued its improving trend and clocked 15% for Q4 of FY26 as against 13.6% in Q3 of FY26

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin target is 15%+ as subsidiaries turn profitable.
items.quote: consolidated levels as an immediate target would be to reach about 15% plus

items.statement: Both RVL and Acemoney subsidiaries targeted to turn PAT positive in H1 FY27.
items.quote: our immediate goal is to turn both of them PAT positive in the current financial year, hopefully, in the first half itself for both of them

items.statement: Company exploring buyback option; discussing with large shareholders and advisors.
items.quote: Currently, we are exploring it also as an option, and we go with detailed discussions with our larger shareholders. And also the consultants and advisers

items.statement: Acemoney signed 2 small finance banks, 1 large NBFC, and several banks for fintech services and network rollout.
items.quote: management has already signed up with two reputed small finance banks, a large NBFC and a few banks to provide fintech services and support their network rollout plans

items.statement: Targets retail contribution to reach 25% of total sales within 2 financial years from current ~10%
items.quote: in upcoming 2 financial years, we would be reaching at least 25% of the total sale as a retail contribution.

items.statement: Retail segment margins expected at 10-12%, higher than current blended EBITDA margin of 6.19%
items.quote: we have surely a higher margin bracket that is somewhere around 10% to 12%.

items.statement: New 10,000 sq ft flagship showroom in Chennai opened 2 months ago; plans to expand smaller stores in Tamil Nadu then pan-India
items.quote: we do have plans of expanding into a retail store, not of the same size of what we have done. We also are a smaller size.

items.statement: Flagship showroom targeting INR 450-500 crores revenue in near future
items.quote: we have defined targets of around INR450 crores to INR500 crores in the near future.

items.statement: Gold price volatility has minimal margin impact due to inventory management and buy-back policies

items.statement: Laminate capacity utilization peaked at 108-110% historically; current 86% with 20% headroom; next expansion only if needed
items.quote: In the past, we have gone up to like 108%, 110% on an annual basis kind of a thing. Of course, in some months, it can be higher than that also. But we can touch around 108%, 110%, but that will depend upon the product mix kind of a thing.

items.statement: Plywood utilization ~45-50% in Q4 FY26; targeting meaningful improvement in FY27 and near full utilization by FY28
items.quote: So, if you look at utilization, Q4, we were nearly at a 45%, 50% kind of utilization, and we hope this will improve this year meaningfully. And probably by FY28, we should come to a near full capacity utilization of the existing plant or near full capacity utilization of the existing plant.

items.statement: Chipboard utilization ~50% in Q4 FY26; expecting continued improvement in FY27
items.quote: As far as utilization is concerned, Q4, we were at nearly 50% utilization in the chipboard business. And I think we should keep improving as we move ahead, Sneha.

items.statement: Targets 4x PAT growth from FY26 to FY29, implying INR40-45 cr PAT by FY29
items.quote: Reflecting our confidence in the opportunities ahead and the scalability of our business models, we have outlined an aspirational aspiration to grow profit after tax by up to 4x from FY26 levels to FY29.

items.statement: Expects gradual PAT growth: ~INR10-12 cr in FY27, ~INR14-16 cr in FY28, ~INR40-45 cr in FY29
items.quote: Ballpark figure I mean, if percentages if I have to look at logically three years, you know, INR30 crores divided by three is INR10 crores each year. Increase.

items.statement: Targets PAT margin expansion to 10%+ from current ~4% by FY29
items.quote: Our target is to increase it to 10% plus.

items.statement: Order book INR506 cr as of May 27, 2026 (~1.9x FY26 revenue), executable over next 3 years
items.quote: As a result of these initiatives and continued customer traction, our order book stood at INR506 crores as of May '26, equivalent to approximately 1.9x of FY26 revenue.

items.statement: India cybersecurity market growing 15-18% YoY; AI-driven threats increasing services demand globally
items.quote: Currently, India market itself is about USD6 billion to USD7 billion and India market is growing from around 15% to 18% year-on-year.

items.statement: Adopted Spot+2% forex pass-through clause in all new contracts to eliminate currency risk
items.quote: So, all our contracts is conversion agnostic. So, customers we are signing up as Spot Plus 2.

items.statement: Imperva sale to Thales caused services revenue drop from INR8.5 cr to INR2 cr in FY26; expects INR6-7 cr from Imperva + INR3 cr from Thales in FY27
items.quote: This year, I'm not, I mean, we are not expecting INR10 crores. We are definitely expecting around INR6 crores to INR7 crores from Imperva and about INR3 crores from Thales.

items.statement: Headcount target 350-375 by March 2027 (from 309 in March 2026) to support services growth
items.quote: We are expecting by March '27, we should be minimum of 350. Between 350 to 375.

items.statement: Geographic expansion: added Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad; Pune opening soon; international via Dubai, Australia, US alliances
items.quote: We continue to strengthen our market presence beyond our traditional strongholds like Bombay. Along with our offices in Mumbai, we expanded our commercial presence into Delhi and increased our focus on growth markets such as Bangalore, Chennai, and Hyderabad.

items.statement: Will only pursue product deals with 9-10%+ margins; dropping all <6% margin product revenue
items.quote: We will not do any product revenue business, okay? Which is anything which is less than 6%. And now we are focusing any product revenue which we are going to do it has to be between 9% to 10%.

items.statement: Large Zscaler deal (INR100+ cr/yr) skews revenue mix and lowers PAT margin; contributes 60% of revenue but <5% of PAT
items.quote: This big order contributes to less than 5% of my bottom line and, you know, 60% on the top line.

items.statement: Added 12 new cybersecurity vendors in FY26 (8 focused, 4-5 case-by-case) expanding into AI security, OT security, post-quantum crypto
items.quote: We onboarded 12 new cybersecurity vendors during FY26, further strengthening our position as one-stop cybersecurity solution providers.

items.statement: FY28 revenue target of INR 700-800 crore with new capacity coming online
items.quote: FY28 we are expecting between 700 to 800 CR.

items.statement: Q4 EBITDA margin pressure from raw material cost increases and acquisition integration costs; expect recovery to 30-35% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: I think in Q1 that EBITDA margin will be more or less similar with the previous whole year's EBITDA margin with the numbers of also EBITDA.

items.statement: No equity dilution planned; INR 65-70 crore term loan for capex, rest from internal accruals; promoter unsecured loan as backup
items.quote: we are planning to get some in terms of term loan from the bank for the at least INR 65 to 70 CR of the term loan and remaining from internal funds.

items.statement: CDMO: 1 of 3 molecules in validation (100kg+ supplied March), commercial supply by Q3 FY27; other 2 validations by Q2 FY27
items.quote: one product out of three, that is already supplied for the in the validation stage of around hundred of in multiple of hundred KGs in month of the March. Uh, commercial supply should be expected by third quarter of FY27

items.quote: Dexketoprofen DMF in Europe is already processed. I think now query we are expecting from EDQM and mostly within next two or three months it should be completed.

items.statement: Order book provides 100% visibility of FY28 internal revenue target and underpins double-digit medium-term growth
items.quote: This provides 100% visibility of our FY 2028 internal revenue target and underpins a double-digit growth trajectory over the medium term.

items.statement: Lifetime order book stands at INR124,000 million as of March 31, 2026
items.quote: As of March 31, 2026, our lifetime order book stands at INR124,000 million after accounting for net additions and programs that commenced production this year.

items.statement: Announced capex of approximately INR1,400 million for new Clean Air facility in North India and Advanced Ride Technologies plant in West India
items.quote: Together, these projects represent an announced capex of approximately INR1,400 million, ensuring we are well-positioned to meet future demand while maintaining operational efficiency.

items.statement: Achieved highest ever full-year EBITDA margin of 18.8% in FY26, up from 14.3% in FY24
items.quote: Importantly, we achieved our highest ever EBITDA margin of 18.8%, expanding by 21 points over the last year. This margin progression from 14.3% in FY24 to 18.8% in FY26 reflects the cumulative benefits of our P3 operating model.

items.statement: DaVinci DCx mechanical suspension adopted by leading Indian OEM for flagship SUV; scope expanding to multiple OEMs across segments
items.quote: A defining highlight this year was the strong validation of our technology leadership through the adoption of DCx DaVinci, a first in the world advanced mechanical suspension system using shim stacks. items.statement: Geopolitical cost pressures (freight, currency, commodities) being mitigated through commercial actions and operational efficiencies
items.quote: These pressures were effectively mitigated through timely commercial actions and ongoing operational efficiencies reflecting the discipline embedded in our operating model.

items.statement: Completed proof-of-concept with European truck OEM for Euro 7 compliant Clean Air solution, strengthening export hub capabilities
items.quote: Finally, just recently in Q4, the company completed a strategic proof-of-concept with a leading European truck OEM for a Euro 7 compliant Clean Air solution, thereby strengthening capabilities in advanced emissions technologies and readiness for future legislations and to further India as an export hub for the world.

items.statement: ROCE improved significantly to 94% in FY26 from 57% in FY25; fixed asset turnover improved to 9.6x from 8.4x
items.quote: Return on capital employed improved significantly to 94%, up from 57% in FY25 reflecting both higher profitability and efficient capital utilization. Fixed assets turnover improved to 9.6 times from 8.4 times in FY25.

items.statement: IPO oversubscribed 61.8x with QIB subscription at 174.8x; stock outperforming BSE Sensex and BSE Auto index since listing
items.quote: Our issue was oversubscribed 61.8 x, with qualified institutional buyers subscribing 174.8 x their allocation. Since the listing, our stock has delivered returns that outperform both the BSE Sensex and the BSE Auto index.

items.statement: Targeting at least 20%+ revenue CAGR over next 3-4 years, confident of exceeding market standard
items.quote: Our plan is to grow by at least 20%-plus CAGR, which is in line with the market standard, but we are confident we will do much more.

items.statement: Order book stands at Rs 600 crore with Rs 330 crore yet to be executed
items.quote: We have an order book of 600 crore. Of this, it is a very active order book: around 230 to 235 crore has been executed, and about 330 crore is yet to be executed.

items.statement: Expect significant increase in international revenue contribution in FY27 from 26-27% in FY26
items.quote: For the total financial year, close to 26 to 27% of revenue came from the international region, but with the kind of foundation we are laying, we expect a much more significant contribution from the international in region this particular year itself.

items.statement: Middle East expansion delayed due to ongoing geopolitical tensions; will deliver from India initially
items.quote: We wanted to establish an earlier presence in the Middle East, but because of ongoing tensions, we are watching this cautiously. We may look at some of the opportunities by delivering from India, and expand later.

items.statement: PAT margin improved from 7.77% to 9.58% in FY26; Q4 EBITDA margin down due to strategic investments
items.quote: The PAT margin increased from 7.77% to 9.58%, and PAT increased from 9 crore 65 lakh to 16 crore, which is almost a 67% increase.

items.statement: Used IPO funds to reduce long-term borrowing significantly; net worth increased substantially
items.quote: Our long-term borrowing has also decreased, because we used some of the IPO funds to cut down the debt, which is a significant milestone, and our net worth has increased significantly as well.

items.statement: AI-as-a-service market growing at 31% CAGR globally and ~30% in India; building consulting-led practices and services
items.quote: The global AI-as-a-service market is going to grow at a 31% CAGR, and the India market is also close to 30% CAGR. The question is how we can have more play in this, in a more services-enabled way.

items.statement: Guides 50-60% revenue and PAT growth for FY27 driven by international expansion and higher deal sizes
items.quote: We are expecting an increase of 50 to 60% on both the revenue side and the PAT side.

items.statement: Targets 50-55% export revenue share in next two years from current 28-30%
items.quote: In the current year, close to 28 to 30% has come from exports, Nikhil. We want to increase it to 50 to 55% in the next two years.

items.statement: Current order book of Rs 600 crore with Rs 380 crore executable; 30-35% of executable portion to be billed in FY27
items.quote: Out of this 380 crore, close to 30 to 35% will be billed this financial year, and the rest will be for the next two to three years.

items.quote: In domestic, the gross margin lies anywhere between 22 and 24%. In international, the gross margin is around 30 to 35%.

items.statement: Targets infrastructure business to contribute 30-35% of revenue in 2-3 years; IP products to contribute 15-20% in 3 years
items.quote: In the next two to three years, this is going to contribute around 30 to 35%.

items.statement: Plans to grow customer base from 150 to 500-600 in 3-4 years via international expansion, IP, partnerships and hybrid sales model
items.quote: That is the target. That is the target.

items.statement: Evaluating inorganic growth with 3-4 target companies; seeking product and services firms for portfolio expansion and regional diversification
items.quote: We are talking to three or four companies in this regard.

items.statement: Identifies cash flow as main challenge for high growth execution; has investor and institutional backing for large orders
items.quote: The main challenge could only be cash flow, because we are aiming for higher growth, but that is addressable and not a major challenge.

items.quote: Where your revenue is going up, you should ordinarily have the benefit of economies of scale, rather than that there is a significant percentage-wise increase, which impacted the Q4 results significantly.

items.quote: And the machine that we are expecting, though there was some delay in the funds availability, but we are still expecting by end of September, this machine will also be producing.

items.quote: So here there was a volume drop of 17%, as I said, one specific reason of the machine modification shirt. And the same has impacted on the PVT also to almost 50% drop.

items.quote: 540, 500 is the NCD. 40 is a green shoe. I mean, that's a question that has been built into the system, basically. And that green shoe will always be at the option of the lender.

items.quote: In terms of asset turnover, we are definitely looking at upwards of 500 crores in terms of revenue on the base paper. So that is the, that's the effort. But of course, things change significantly as we crack the flexible code.

items.quote: In terms of EBITDA margins, we will definitely look to come towards where we were earlier, which was around the mark of 22 to 25 odd percent.

items.quote: So at any point of time, your working capital requirement will not be in the tune of 50 crores which you're talking about, it will be between 45 and 50 crores, but definitely there'll be internal accruals coming and saved into the system.

items.statement: Expect ~30% year-on-year revenue growth beyond FY27
items.quote: Yes, around 30% is what we have projected also, and we are confident of that year-on-year.

items.quote: Right now, we have a confirmed order book of close to about 1,100 crores plus for next financial year, minimum confirmed order book.

items.quote: CAPEX, we are expecting at least Rs. 150 crores -Rs. 200 crores as a minimum budget that we have made at an initial stage of it, which might have a little upside of it.

items.statement: Data center first line expected ready by Q1 2027; will reduce cloud costs (currently 15-35% of recurring cost) and improve margins
items.quote: So, data center side, we are expecting a first line of the data centers would be ready by the 1st Quarter of 2027 at least that's what we are aiming at to focus on to it and the margins would be pretty good in it.

items.quote: Yes, we have received in-principle sanctions from BSE recently, and that's a recent acknowledgement that we have in-principle approval received. Now we have to conduct a meeting and follow the due process.

items.quote: Around that. around Rs. 170 crores to Rs. 180 crores plus, we would be having the revenue which has been contributed from the AIS Anywhere and even side of it for this particular half year.
