items.statement: FY27 capex guided at INR 60-75 crore for infrastructure, capacity expansion and technology
items.quote: The growth will be underpinned by a capex of around INR60 crores to INR75 crores this year across the infrastructure and capacity expansion along with the technology implementation.

items.quote: So, there have been increase in raw material cost, but we each orders we are quoting, there is a clause called PVC, Price Variation Clause.

items.quote: There was a little slowdown in the wagon industry, but now as you see new 1 lakh wagon order is coming into place, that wagon industry would again start go into hike now.

items.quote: Currently I can say the track section have contributed approximately INR20 crores in a revenue. And in future we see that increasing to INR60 crores to INR70 crores in two financial year.

items.quote: You will hear the commencement of the plant within June itself. So, first invoices would be raised in the month of June.

items.quote: Right now, we have order around INR8 crores to INR10 crores which we have not executed, and we will execute it in this quarter.

items.quote: Once everything settles and business is mature as you are saying, our EBITDA margin should be around 30%, 32% in normal case and 15% to 17% as PAT.

items.quote: Second, in terms of capex, I think we have a normal capex would be there in next three years of about INR200 crores to INR300 crores. And we would be putting these into the capacity for biologicals primarily.

items.quote: Long term we will get significant market share, about 20%, 25% of resistant cases everywhere. In India, we might get little bit better. Let us see.

items.statement: Zaynich approved for cUTI with label covering carbapenem-resistant pathogens; HAP/VAP study planned for indication expansion
items.quote: However, I mean we are going to do one more study which is a very important study called hospital acquired pneumonia and ventilator associated pneumonia where we are going to intentionally enrol the patient with carbapenem resistant pathogen and that will lead to a further expansion of indication as well as much more c

items.statement: Next antibiotic product (Odrate) at least 4 years away; strategy focused only on Zaynich currently
items.quote: To be very frank with you we have strategy only for Zaynich today and then we have to take a call which is next product we will go and go ahead and we don't believe any product can come less than 4 years.

items.statement: Biosimilar capacity to double in 12-15 months; biosimilar business grew 35% last year and expected to double in 24-36 months
items.quote: So, as far as biosimilar is concerned, we had about 35% growth in the last year, and I think we will double our business within the next 24 to 36 months. We are also investing in increasing our capacity, and by doing that, we will double our capacity in the next 12 to 15 months.

items.statement: No Phase 2 waiver expected for Odrate due to dose change from 1g to 2g; Phase 2 trial planned before proceeding
items.quote: We have changed our dose from 1 to 2 grams. And I don't believe we would get a waiver. Even if we don't get waiver, from our point of view, we would want to do Phase 2 trial before we proceed.

items.statement: Foviscu filing to DCGI expected in 2-3 months; approval timing unpredictable
items.quote: And Foviscu, we are about to file it in another month or two, in another two, three months we are about to file to DCGI. And I think we should receive approval whenever DCGI gives approval, that is not predictable nowadays.

items.statement: No partnership strategy for Zaynich; building own commercial organization globally to leverage pipeline of 6 QIDP-designated molecules
items.quote: No. See, our strategy is very clear because partnership option we did consider over last 12 months. And then after various stages of consideration, we have come to a strategic decision to build the business ourselves because we are not a one-product wonder. We have a range of products coming out over the years.

items.statement: US anti-infective market for new antibiotics ~$1 billion collectively; new anti-infectives typically achieve $30-50 million in first 3 years
items.quote: So, I can tell you that historically anti-infectives, new anti-infectives that have been launched in the first three-odd years do about maybe 30 to 50 million collectively over that period of time.

items.statement: Company committed to antibiotic research only for next 10 years; no plans for chronic disease molecules
items.quote: I can guarantee you one thing. We will stick to only antibiotic research for next 10 years.

items.statement: Delivered ~200 bps EBITDA margin improvement in FY2026 through cost rationalization across real estate, technology, and infrastructure
items.quote: We took clear actions to rationalize our cost base across real estate, technology, and infrastructure, which has helped us deliver around 200 basis points of margin improvement.

items.statement: Q4 FY2026 EBITDA margin at 15.7%, up sequentially; full year margin at 13.4%
items.quote: Total income stood at Rs. 1,255 crores with EBITDA at Rs. 197 crores and margin at 15.7%.

items.statement: Signed 79 new clients in FY2026, strongest year ever for new logos across BPM and Digital services
items.quote: FY2026 has been our strongest year ever, with 79 new clients signed on across BPM and Digital services.

items.statement: Capital deployed in AI-led centers of excellence, package solutions, broadband and CelerityX expansions in FY2026; will continue in FY2027 H1
items.quote: On strategic priorities, capital was deployed in AI-led centers of excellence, package solutions and the broadband and CelerityX expansions while maintaining a conservative leverage.

items.statement: Income tax case related to NXTDIGITAL merger sub-judice; appeal filed in Bombay High Court, next hearing June 12
items.quote: So, you are referring to the GAAR panel case that is? Yes. So, that is currently sub-judiced and we have filed an appeal with Bombay High Court, and the next hearing is on 12th of June.

items.statement: Net treasury and cash surplus of Rs. 5,346 crores provides flexibility to fund AI framework and Project Ganga without external raise
items.quote: Net treasury and cash surplus stood at around Rs. 5,346 crores, which gives us enough flexibility for us to invest behind the realized AI framework and Project Ganga without compromising returns.

items.statement: Media business expects to share Project Ganga and CelerityX traction timeline by end of Q2 FY2027
items.quote: If you allow us to share at the end of Q2, the traction that we have gained on Project Ganga as well as other initiatives like CelerityX, perhaps we will be able to explain it in greater detail in terms of the timeline.

items.statement: Targeting higher side double-digit revenue growth of 20% and above for FY27
items.quote: Higher side double-digit growth, you can say 20% and above.

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margin of approximately 8% to 9% going forward
items.quote: EBITDA margin that we are -- of course, we cannot disclose the number, but I can say approximately 8% to 9% going forward.

items.statement: Plan to open 8 to 10 stores in FY27, expanding into western MMR suburbs, Pune, and potentially Gujarat
items.quote: We plan on opening 8 to 10 stores every year. We plan on expanding to western suburban's as well as PCMC.

items.statement: Q4 EBITDA margin decline due to upfront costs from new store additions; revenue ramp-up expected in coming quarters
items.quote: So, basically, the lower margins in Q4 is on account of the additions into new stores. Basically, new stores carry an upfront cost and their revenue gets ramped up into coming quarters.

items.statement: Retail EBITDA margin in range of 7% to 8%; manufacturing EBITDA margin roughly 6.5% to 7%
items.quote: EBITDA margin for our retail business in the range of 7.5% to 8%.

items.statement: Own brand gross margins at 30% to 35%; non-branded gross margins at 15% to 16%
items.quote: In our own brands, the margins, yes, the operating margins goes up to 30% to 35%.

items.statement: Raw material prices have peaked and are declining; expect inventory gains from competitive procurement
items.quote: They are all the commodities have already reached their peak price and come, declining more right now. We hope it keeps on declining.

items.statement: Private label contributes 17.5% of retail sales; aim to increase share for margin improvement
items.quote: Out of INR429 crores, 17.5% consists of our private label sales.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of INR115 crores deployed into working capital in FY26
items.quote: In the fiscal '26, we have successfully completed the IPO where we have deployed INR115 crores into working capital.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at manufacturing facilities improved to 50-55% from 45-48%
items.quote: Now it is in between 50% to 55%, depending on different machineries and different units, but it has grown by 4% to 5%.

items.statement: Integration benefit of INR1,000-1,500 per ton from captive billet plant and hot charging to sustain through FY27
items.quote: And this benefit of INR1,500 a ton will be carried throughout the year.

items.statement: Strong demand outlook in Gujarat driven by infra push, high-rise approvals (60 floors), Commonwealth Games 2030, Olympics 2036 bid
items.quote: Also, there is a lot of infra push which is happening across the country and especially in Gujarat with 2030 Commonwealth Games and a lot of high-rise projects.

items.statement: Key risk: TMT is a commodity with daily price volatility; West Asia war causing supply disruptions
items.quote: this is TMT is a commodity product. So, there is of course, price rise and price reduction on a daily basis. So, due to recent war also, the West Asia war, there has been supply disruptions and everything

items.statement: No expansion planned for next 2-3 years; focus on utilizing existing 3 lakh ton permitted capacity (70-75% utilized)
items.quote: Currently, the management team is not looking at the expansion. Currently, we are looking at utilizing the optimum production and the sales capacity of our plant.

items.statement: No bulk quarterly orders; daily dispatch ~500 tons, 24-hour fulfillment from dealer network
items.quote: Those orders are usually for, you can say, 20 odd days, like every day approximately our dispatch is about 500 tons. And whenever such orders come, so within 24 hours, we try to serve them.

items.statement: 100% internal billet production from scrap; zero external billet procurement
items.quote: right now, we are not procuring any billets from outside. We are completely dependent on the scrap procurement, and through that, we are manufacturing our own billets

items.statement: FY27 growth expected to be stronger than FY26 due to full-year integration benefit, solar savings, and Gujarat demand
items.quote: in Financial Year 27, the growth will be strong and the company would be performing better than what it was because in this year, we will also be having a generation from our 15-megawatt solar plant

items.statement: Targets Robotics & AI revenue share to reach 60-65% in FY27 from ~36-37% in FY26
items.quote: We are expecting around 60%, 65%, 60% nearby at least comes from a robotics and AI division

items.statement: Secured INR6.6 crore AI automation order from Pointer Insurance Broker
items.quote: We recently secured a significant AI automation solution order worth INR6.6 crores from Pointer Insurance Broker Private Limited.

items.statement: Experience Center ~95% complete, expected to open very soon
items.quote: Almost 95% of the work is already being done. We are expecting to get a date ready very soon going to open our Experience Center

items.statement: RSVP Infotech acquisition (INR98 lakhs) to contribute INR15-20 crores revenue in FY27 from existing clients plus new AI/software wins
items.quote: This year, we are expecting at least INR15 crores to INR20 crores of business to come from RSVP's existing clients that we are going to serve under Nanta Tech Limited this year.

items.statement: Targets 25-30% top-line growth in FY27 over FY26
items.quote: We can consider a growth and overall growth of around 25% to 30% on our top line from the last year.

items.statement: Order book of INR 320-330 crores in hand, covering 6-7 months visibility
items.quote: We already, as I've said before, we have orders in hand for 6 to 7 months in hand always. This time also, we have orders upwards of INR320 crores, INR330 crores in hand.

items.statement: Adding 12-13 packing lines by end of September; constructing new plant wing; expanding functional food and wet food facilities
items.quote: Even as we speak, we are adding another 12 to 13 packing lines by end of September. We will have -- we are also going to construct a new wing within the plant.

items.statement: Expects PAT margin of 10-12% in next few years on 2-3x current top line; EBITDA margins to rise for 8 quarters then spike as demographic reach saturates
items.quote: Within the next few years, you're easily looking 10% to 12% PAT kind of company on a 2x, 3x kind of top line within the next few years.

items.statement: Raw material costs up 1-2% due to geopolitical issues; buffered by 3-4 months stock; able to pass on increases; no bottom-line impact
items.quote: Few percentage, 1% or 2%, the buyer absorbs sometimes certain products we have to absorb, but it has absolutely no difference to our bottom line.

items.statement: Mobility division targets INR 100 cr run rate in 2.5 years and INR 250-300 cr in 5-7 years; growing at 55-60% CAGR
items.quote: We do not foresee any problem in touching INR100 crores within a 2 to 2.5 years from now, calendar 2.5 calendar years from now and INR100 crores run rate.

items.statement: New-age businesses (pet care, mobility, nutraceuticals, cosmetics) growing at 40-50% CAGR with 45-55% gross margins; target 50:50 split with vintage in few years, then 70:30
items.quote: Within the next 2, 3 years post that, it will be around 70% to 30%.

items.statement: Launching hormonal and anti-aging lines (NAD+, medicated hormone products online first in India); Wagr.in pet platform soft launch mid-June, full launch early July
items.quote: We also will be the first ones to have medicated harmone products sold online through our website and through our doctor channel, which is available, which will be the first ones in the country to do so.

items.statement: In-house manufacturing >80%; 43 loan-license locations; adding packing lines and new plant wing; top 3-4 manufacturing capacity at single location in 2.5 years
items.quote: Right now, I would say about 80% of our products or more than 80% gets manufactured in-house. In-house capacities are augmented. They are expanding.

items.statement: Pet care revenue INR 42-43 cr in FY26; target 'no pet born or dies without Freossi product by 2032-33'; 42 biscuit variants launching; Stage 4 trials for novel pet formulations in 12 months
items.quote: Our long-term goal is very crystal clear substant and simple that by 2032, 2033, no pet in India can be born or die without using a Freossi product or service.

items.statement: Mobility pre-bookings full for July launch; Mobilitics (physio-focused) alone targets INR 30-40 cr in 2 years; Maharashtra-level distribution target in 17-18 states in 2.5 years
items.quote: Hopefully, that alone should go into INR30 crores to INR40 crores in the next 2 years, just the Mobilitics part of Fredun Mobility.

items.statement: Finance cost ratios improving; absolute debt may rise but cost percentage to decline over 3-4 years as credit rating improves
items.quote: Within the next 3 to 4 years, you will see a pretty different picture when it comes to this in terms of your percentage of the spend.

items.statement: Order book stands at ~₹1,400 crore diversified across dredging, charter hire and shipbuilding with long tenure providing revenue visibility
items.quote: As of Financial Year 26, KMEW has a diversified order book of approx ₹ 1,400 crores spread across dredging, charter hire and shipbuilding. Importantly, a substantial portion of this order book carries long duration tenure, thereby enhancing revenue predictability and cash flow visibility.

items.statement: Bid pipeline exceeds ₹2,000 crore (domestic only) expected to convert over next 3 months; no slowdown in order booking
items.quote: we have a bi d pipeline in excess of ₹ 2,000 crores. And these orders are expected to flow in over a period of next 3 months. So there is no slowdown in either bidding or the upcoming orders.

items.statement: Expects Q1 FY27 revenue >₹100 crore with EBITDA margin improvement over 40% as ₹60 crore spillover revenue recognized
items.quote: I believe it is going to be more than ₹ 100 crores, the revenue for Q1 and EBITDA margins should be an improvement than 40%.

items.statement: All contracts have fuel pass-through clauses; rising fuel costs from West Asia conflict have no negative margin impact
items.quote: all of our contracts have a fuel pass -through. So it hasn't resulted into any negative impact on the company.

items.statement: River Pearl 47 (India's largest self-propelled backhoe dredger) utilization expected >240 days/year for next 2-3 years across 5 major ports
items.quote: We see utilization in excess of 240 days per year for River Pearl 47 in the next at least 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: Shipyard at Saphale designed for 10-120m vessels; targets 14 vessels/year when fully functional; export orders expected from Q3/Q4 FY27
items.quote: we are projecting to deliver 14 vessels. When the yard is fully functional, that is being able to build and deliver 14 vessels per year. And we are currently marketing that. We believe the export orders will start flowing in either Q3 or Q4 of the current financial year.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target INR200 crores; FY28 expected 15-20% growth over FY27
items.quote: So, we are expecting around INR200 crores worth of revenue for current year, and next year, we are expecting around 15% to 20% growth from current year.

items.statement: Current order book INR50-60 crores
items.quote: Our current order book, as I mentioned in my speech, it is around INR50 crores to INR60 crores.

items.statement: XDuce partnership expected $1-2M revenue in FY27, $3-5M in FY28 growing 15-20% YoY
items.quote: So, this year, we are expecting around $1 million to $2 million business from XDuce, and from next year, from FY27, we are expecting around a $3 million to $5 million of business, and that will grow 15% to 20% year-on-year.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin declined due to India market focus, strategic integration costs, and talent investment
items.quote: So, we consciously decided that we will focus more on India market, even though our margins are low so that we don't have any existential issues. It is another region. Third one is after October or November, the strategic alliance and the partnership has taken lots of time as well as strategic bandwidth.

items.statement: Geopolitical risk mitigation via India market focus despite lower margins; integration delays with XDuce and UCI partnerships
items.quote: We don't want to dilute everything to our export business so that any geopolitical situation can disrupt our company existence. So, though our India market is not so attractive as compared to export market as far as our profitability is concerned, but it gives us lots of learning.

items.statement: Transferred Talligence and ByteSIGNER products to Technosys for INR11.90 crores to focus on core services business
items.quote: The Board approved the transfer of Talligence and product businesses to Technosys Private Limited for cash consideration of approximately INR11.90 crores. We believe this step will support better value creation and allow greater focus on scaling our core technological service business.

items.statement: Targets INR250 cr revenue, INR25 cr PAT, and 50-50 IP/services mix over next 3 years
items.quote: Our next 3-year targets remain unchanged: INR250 crores in revenue, INR25 crores in PAT, and a 50-50 IP to services revenue mix over the next three years

items.statement: Aims to reach 50% IP revenue contribution in 2 years, up from current 10-15%
items.quote: We are targeting to reach an IP revenue of 50% contribution in 2 years' time on our way to the 50%-50% split that we've committed to

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expanded to 14.44% from 10.78% YoY; Q4 margin hit 16.52%
items.quote: EBITDA came in at INR17.1 crores, up 76% year-on-year, with margins expanding meaningfully to 14.44% from 10.78%

items.statement: 6-7 IP projects lined up for FY27 from Moving Images; 3-4 advanced OTT IP-sharing deals in pipeline
items.quote: So, there's a pipeline of about six to seven IPs that have already been lined up. I think that is already in progress

items.statement: Current revenue mix 80-85% commissioned, 10-15% IP; target 50-50 in 3 years
items.quote: Our revenue mix today stands at approximately 80% to 85% of commissioned content and 10% to 15% of IP-related revenues

items.statement: Funded acquisitions and AI launch via last year's rights issue proceeds and internal accruals
items.quote: So, the funding came from the rights issue that we did last year. From those, from the proceeds of that and certain accruals, we've been funding all these acquisitions

items.statement: No immediate fundraise planned; may consider in 2-3 years if pipeline mismatch arises
items.quote: We are looking at a pipeline for the next two to three years. If there is a mismatch that we would figure out, then we may go into more further fundraise, but nothing at the moment

items.statement: Zero regulatory/censorship risk as content follows established legal frameworks
items.quote: So, we are completely following those guidelines, so we have zero risk when it comes to actually getting our content censored or taken down

items.statement: Promoter holding ~25%; plan to increase significantly over next 2-3 years
items.quote: There is definitely a plan to get it up to a decently significant holding. That is work in progress right now, and the plan over the next 2 years is 2 to 3 years is to make sure that there is a significant increase

items.statement: Face value consolidation from INR1 to INR10 under active Board discussion
items.quote: So, that has been an active discussion with management and the Board. We are working towards getting towards that and those discussions have been on

items.statement: Assam creator park blueprint in progress; revenue contribution expected after 1 year
items.quote: We're building the blueprint and the plan for this. We should be able to make a certain update announcement on it over the next one quarter

items.statement: AI (CastMatch) targets 30-40% script-to-screen time savings and 20-40% cost savings
items.quote: The larger ambition is to move towards agentic AI and AI content creation, which compresses our script-to-screen timelines to about 30% to 40% of time that we save in terms of creating content and almost 20% to 40% of content savings

items.statement: Management expects 15% revenue growth in FY27.
items.quote: We expect to grow by 15% this year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin targeted at 23-24% for FY27, up from 17.36% in FY26.
items.quote: I'm very confident that we will be achieving 23% or 24% of EBITDA, FY27.

items.statement: Third manufacturing unit expansion underway.
items.quote: We are investing in our future, as shown by the expansion of our third manufacturing unit.

items.statement: Order book as of June 2026 is better than June 2025.
items.quote: It is better than the last year. If you talk about the period-to-period comparison, say, June 2026 and June 2025, we are better off this year.

items.statement: Exhibition spend to drop from 14 events (INR5 cr) to 5 events in FY27, saving INR3.5-4 cr.
items.quote: So this year, in FY27, we would be only participating in 5 exhibitions. So 10 exhibitions, if you remove them, that itself will save us approximately INR3.5 crores or INR4 crores.

items.statement: Subsidized API seal supply cost INR8 cr in FY26; will taper down in FY27 with selective quoting (~300-350 seals).
items.quote: And also last year, we invested approximately INR8 crores, which was below cost of raw material to supply API seals and which was the highest so far. So even that would taper down.

items.statement: Middle East project delays of ~7 months due to geopolitical tension; new project pipeline remains strong.
items.quote: If you ask me as of today, we are delayed by 7 months.

items.statement: Aftermarket spare parts business carries ~80% gross margin; replacement revenue expected from April 2027.
items.quote: As I think communicated many times in our earnings calls, our gross margins for this post-fit seal, which we call them as spare part business would be around 80%.

items.statement: Target to add ~300 API seals in FY27; cautious on volume to protect margins and cash flow.
items.quote: For next year, say 900, we expect to add for FY27, say about 300 seals more on the API.

items.statement: Geopolitical instability in Middle East deferring commissioning by 6-9 months; inventory rose to INR62 cr due to delayed shipments and rare earth supply concerns.
items.quote: Unfortunately, due to the geopolitical situation in the Middle East, the commissioning has got deferred by, say, about 6 or 9 months.

items.statement: May need capital infusion (debt or equity) if aggressive API seal subsidization continues.
items.quote: If we are going for more API infusion -- API seal infusion, and if we're going to subsidize and take many orders, at that time, we may need capital infusion either by creating debt or by some other means.

items.statement: Nuclear seal quoting active for Kudankulam expansion and with BHEL; long lead time of 2-3 years to order, 2 years execution.
items.quote: Yes, we are actively quoting for nuclear applications for the new expansion for Kudankulam, which is in Tamil Nadu. And also, we are actively liaising with BHEL and other nuclear pump companies globally as well as in India.

items.statement: No currency hedging; USD appreciation benefits replacement revenue (80% gross margin) but increases import costs.
items.quote: No, we don't do any kind of hedging. In fact, it works both ways because your realization also goes up, but at the same time, your imports also get hit.

items.statement: Management expects to maintain strong momentum in FY27 and reiterates 25% EPS CAGR guidance, noting base is now larger at INR26 EPS vs INR6 when first guided
items.quote: I think our sort of philosophy here at Aegis is really to not to overpromise, always to under promise, and hopefully overdeliver. So, that's our conservative management philosophy. But I'm confident that, you know, FY27 will continue the strong momentum that we have.

items.statement: Cumulative capex expected to reach $1.2 billion by March 2027, with additional INR5,000 crores in FY28, targeting $5 billion total by December 2030 (FY31)
items.quote: We will see a $1.2 billion aggregate capex by March '27 that we have already shared. March '28, we would again see a capex up to INR5,000 crores coming in. This is both organic inorganic as such.

items.statement: LPG distribution margin of INR7,000/ton expected sustainable through FY27-FY28, supported by volume-driven procurement efficiencies offsetting potential energy price normalization
items.quote: Going forward, we feel the INR7,000-odd margins should be sustainable as beyond '26, '27, we would see our distribution volumes really of a scale that brings procurement efficiencies, which will -- when the prices of energy stabilize or come down, will compensate in terms of margins.

items.statement: LPG supply situation improving month-on-month; shortfall down to 30% in May from 50% in April; normalcy expected by Q2 FY27 as alternative supply sources from Canada, US, Argentina, Nigeria replace Middle East dependency
items.quote: In May, the shortfall is down to 30% when it was 50% in April. In May, it has been better, and we expect this improvement to continue, probably in Q2, sometime in Q2, we should see normalcy return back.

items.statement: Gas distribution target of 2 million tons by FY28 including LPG and ammonia; ammonia terminal at Pipavav (36,000 MT) backed by 15-year take-or-pay with Hindustan Zinc for 1/3 capacity, 2/3 open access; ammonia distribution margins up to INR
items.quote: We always had a target of 2 million tons. So, we expect that to reach by '28. And mind you, we are also commissioning ammonia. So, then that means that ammonia distribution would form part of this 2 million gas distribution that we intend to do.

items.statement: Secured 15-year take-or-pay agreement with leading conglomerate for petroleum products at Pipavav liquid terminal; committed volumes exceed 0.5 million metric tons annually with operations expected by year-end
items.quote: Committed volumes exceed 0.5 million metric tons per year annually with operations expected to commence by year-end.

items.statement: Mumbai expansion: 64,000 KL liquid storage at INR125 cr, commissioning H1 FY27; JNPT expansion: 318,100 KL liquid, 77,236 MT LPG, bottling plant at INR1,675 cr, first phase H1 FY27; Pipavav ammonia terminal INR525 cr, commissioning H1 FY27
items.quote: We are developing an additional 64,000 kilolitres of liquid storage at a project cost of INR125 crores, which is progressing on schedule with a commissioning targeted for the first half of FY '27 this year.

items.statement: Vadhavan port MoU for potential INR20,000 cr investment subject to approvals and land allocation; only portion likely included in $5bn capex plan; timeline uncertain
items.quote: We have signed, sorry, a nonbinding memorandum of understanding to participate in the development of this port with a potential investment of approximately INR20,000 crores, subject to approvals and land allocation, of course.

items.statement: Ammonia terminal throughput margins expected INR2,500-3,000/ton; distribution margins up to INR5,000/ton; utilization ~25% first year growing 30-40% YoY; distribution volumes ~200,000 tons first year growing 20-30% YoY
items.quote: In the current year, we expect around -- as we do in LPG, we expect around 25% utilization in the first year and thereafter growing at the rate of 30%, 40% year-on-year. Distribution similarly, we expect somewhere around 200,000 tons to begin with and then growing 20%, 30% year-on-year.

items.statement: Itochu Corporation acquired 10% stake in Aegis Terminal Pipavav Limited with intention to raise to 25% over 3 years as strategic partner for ammonia and LPG infrastructure
items.quote: Itochu Corporation has acquired a 10% stake in Aegis Terminal Pipavav Limited coming in as a strategic partner with an intention to raise that to 25% stake over the next 3 years.

items.statement: Cash and investments grew from INR150 cr in FY22 to INR5,939 cr in FY26; targeting gearing ratio ~0.6x; funding through balanced mix of equity, internal accruals and debt
items.quote: Cash and investments have grown from INR150 crores in FY22, just 4 years back to INR5,939 crores in FY26, a transformation that positions us to fund growth at pace without compromising financial discipline.

items.statement: FY26 results: Revenue INR8,333 cr (+23%), Normalized EBITDA INR1,599 cr (+36%), PAT INR1,107 cr (+41%); Q4 FY26: Revenue INR2,594 cr (+52%), EBITDA INR670 cr (+54%), PAT INR455 cr (+43%); Final dividend INR6.70/sh (total INR8.70/sh)
items.quote: It was an outstanding year, a breakout year for us. So, the revenues grew 23% year-on-year to INR8,333 crores. Normalized EBITDA rose 36% to INR1,599 crores. Profit after tax grew 41% to INR1,107 crores crossing the symbolic INR1,000 crores profit after tax milestone for the first time.

items.statement: Kandla VLGC-compliant terminal operational; Jamnagar-Loni LPG pipeline complete; Kandla-Gorakhpur pipeline connection expected H1 FY27; CRL 4 liquid terminal (94,148 KL) commissioning next year; MoU with L&T for ammonia terminals at Kandla
items.quote: In December, the group successfully handled a VLGC vessel, making Kandla a VLGC-compliant terminal. And the Jamnagar-Loni pipeline, LPG pipeline is complete. And the Kandla-Gorakhpur LPG pipeline is expected to be connected in H1 FY27, further improving evacuation efficiency.

items.statement: Haldia: acquired 75% stake in Hindustan Aegis LPG (25,000 MT LPG storage) with exclusive HPCL agreement through 2038; acquired 3 acres for future expansion; Mangalore: 82,000 MT cryogenic LPG terminal commissioned June 2025; rail gantry und
items.quote: At the Haldia port, switching to the other coast, we completed the acquisition of a 75% stake in Hindustan Aegis LPG Limited during the year, adding approximately 25,000 metric tons of LPG storage, and marking our entry into the East Coast market.

items.statement: Home appliances division targets north of 20% revenue growth in FY27, with first two months on track.
items.quote: We are on track as far as the revenue side is concerned. However, we, on the BOM, there is this issue. As I said, that our cost optimization has not been able to recover the negative impact of commodity and Forex.

items.statement: Engineering division targets 20-25% revenue growth over next 2-3 years on existing business, plus new verticals.
items.quote: Over the next 2 to 3 years, the - what we have planned is a 20% to 25% growth on the existing business. We are also in the process of adding new revenue streams to our business, for example, EV battery parts, motorcycle chains, manufacturing and brake disc.

items.statement: Engineering division targets EBITDA margin of 17-18% (currently ~15%).
items.quote: Target EBITDA margin is 17% to 18%. We already do about 15%. So there is a 17% to 18% EBITDA margin we are targeting.

items.statement: Home appliances capex was INR 43 cr in FY26; engineering division spent INR 63 cr of approved INR 100 cr, balance carried to FY27.
items.quote: Current year total company-wide number is INR 89 crores, okay, INR 88.6 to be precise. Out of that, home appliance division is - I'm telling you home appliance division is around INR 43 crores.

items.statement: Commodity + forex impact INR 84 cr in FY26; INR 67 cr offset via cost optimization; INR 29 cr realized in Apr-May FY27, targeting INR 120 cr more in next 10 months.
items.quote: If you look at the full year, the impact on commodity as well as forex was INR 32 crores and INR 52 crores totaling to INR 84 crores. But INR 67 crores of that, we were able to make up because of our cost optimization program.

items.statement: Price increases taken in Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 across almost all categories to pass on cost inflation.
items.quote: We did something in Q4 and Q1 of this year, we have already taken price increases in almost all our categories.

items.statement: Home appliances revenue grew 11% YoY in Q4 FY26; front load volume +20% YoY in Q4, top load +19% full year; AC growth muted.
items.quote: In front loader, we had a good double-digit growth in this quarter. And top loader has been good for us, and we have been able to improve our market share, again, a very good double-digit growth.

items.statement: Portfolio simplification: front load models cut from 58 to 25; similar rationalization across categories to drive premiumization and reduce SKUs.
items.quote: We have reduced our number of models that are there in each one of the categories. That has been a very conscious effort from our side to simplify the entire process.

items.statement: Energy rating change for ACs from Jan 1 2026 caused INR 7 cr full-year cost impact (INR 6 cr in Q4) from cost increase and liquidation of old stock.
items.value: 7 cr full year, 6 cr in Q4
items.quote: I think it was about INR 7 crores was the impact because of that, INR 7 crores for the full year. And obviously, everything came into Q4. So about INR 6 crores out of that came into Q4.

items.statement: AC market share ~3-3.5%, aspiration to reach double digits in FY27; front load share 23% (25.5-26% ex-12kg), top load 9%.
items.quote: We are currently at about 3, 3.5 percentage is what our market shares are. And that's something that we have to grow significantly. And our aspiration is to get into double digits as far as the market shares are concerned.

items.statement: Import content 30% of manufacturing RM, 39% overall; target to reduce to 25% and 30-32% respectively via indigenization.
items.quote: Import is about 30 percentage is what the import content is. But we also import some units per se. So if you take our manufacturing imports is about 30 percentage. But if you take other imports or everything, put together, currently, it's about 39 percentage.

items.statement: FY27 feed sales estimated around 580,000 MT vs 562,060 MT in FY26
items.quote: It is estimated that the feed sales during FY27 would be around 5,80,000 MTs.

items.statement: FY27 shrimp exports estimated around 19,000 MT vs 16,976 MT in FY26
items.quote: It is estimated that the exports during FY25 would be around 19,000 MT.

items.statement: Current purchase prices: fish meal INR 230/kg, soybean meal INR 72/kg, wheat flour INR 30/kg
items.quote: Present purchase price of fish meal is INR 230 per kg and soya bean meal is INR 72 per kg, and wheat flour is INR 30 per kg.

items.statement: Feed division PBT margin 15.5% in FY26 vs 14.34% in FY25
items.quote: The PBT during the FY26 stood at 15.5% on revenue as compared to about 14.34% during FY25.

items.statement: No major capex foreseen in next two years
items.quote: We don't foresee any big CapEx in the next two years.

items.statement: Shrimp culture progressing well; farm gate prices stable; export market promising
items.quote: The shrimp culture is progressing without much hurdles so far. The export market is promising and also farm gate prices of shrimp is stable to the expectations of the farmers.

items.statement: Raw material cost surge due to Gulf War, El Nino, and 75% fish meal exports; lobbying govt to restrict exports and allow soybean meal imports
items.quote: A major reason attributed is Gulf War on one hand, and added to it is the threat of severe El Nino this year, seriously impacting the rainfall and agricultural crops.

items.statement: Expecting USD 15-20 million refund of reciprocal tariffs paid on US shrimp imports since April 2025
items.quote: Roughly, it will come around USD 15-20 million.

items.statement: Processing division expanding value-added products (ready-to-eat, breaded, Japanese prep); R&D accelerating
items.quote: We do ready to eat, which is cooked products. It's for the kind of straight to consumption. We do breading, we do some shrimp drinks. We do Japanese preparation.

items.statement: Pet care targeting 800 MT sales by end FY27 from ~100 MT now; 31 distributors in 13 cities; importing from Thailand until own plant ready
items.quote: We've been increasing from 53 tons to, right now, 100 tons with goal of 800 MTs by end of this year.

items.statement: Overall group revenue/profit growth target 10-15% in FY27 amid uncertainty; budgeting delayed
items.quote: Overall, the target, if you put around 10-15% growth with the present global situation, it will be a big achievement.

items.statement: US tariff uncertainty: IEEPA tariffs invalidated Feb 2026; temporary 10% surcharge under Section 122 for 150 days; refunds pending anti-dumping reviews (12-18 months)
items.quote: The U.S. Administration subsequently introduced a temporary global import surcharge under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974, effective from the same date for a period up to 150 days.

items.statement: Unexecuted order book stands at Rs 850 crore plus with a tender pipeline of Rs 1,500 crore plus across all segments
items.quote: Okay, so the current, unexecuted order book is around Rs. 850 crore plus, and the tender pipeline is around Rs. 1,500 crore plus.

items.statement: Management sees multi-fold growth in power sector over 15 years driven by Rs 9 lakh crore transmission investment by 2032, RDSS Phase 2 digitalization, and 102 GW floating solar potential
items.quote: I think till 2047, power is one sector that we believe will grow multi-fold in the next, I think, 15 years. So that is the market opportunity that we are able to see.

items.statement: No formal FY27 revenue guidance given; management expects better performance than FY26's Rs 401.59 crore with improved execution buffers
items.quote: I am not supposed to give guidance right now, because we are speaking very early this year. But yes, I can definitely tell you about the order book we have, which is unexecuted, I think it is around 850 plus crores. So, we believe that we'll be doing better than the last year, that is for sure.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 loss of Rs 7.07 crore reversed to Q4 net profit of Rs 9.3 crore through execution catch-up, better material availability, stronger project mix and tighter operating discipline
items.quote: The company moved from a loss of Rs. 7.07 crore in Q3 to a net profit of Rs. 9.3 crore in Q4. This improvement was supported by better execution, improved material availability, project catch-up, stronger project mix, and tighter operating discipline.

items.statement: Project execution delays from extended rainfall in Maharashtra, China-linked solar supply chain disruptions, safeguard duty cost movements, and procurement lead times extended by ~2 months
items.quote: Extended rainfall delayed site-level activity majorly in Maharashtra, and this shifted part of the execution cycle further into the second half. In the solar EPC business, China-linked supply chain disruption, safeguard duty-related cost movements, and higher-cost solar input costs affected earlier project assumptions.

items.statement: R&D investment ongoing for PulseBox and next project; technology developed via domestic and international teams; products made in India with technology from Western partners; no specific capex number disclosed
items.quote: We have developed this technology through our domestic and international teams. And that is where, Sad has asked about the collaborations, and also this is ongoing, and this is the outcome of that effort, what we have made. Still, we are doing it, still we are focusing on it.

items.statement: Promoter family may increase stake in coming months as stock down >75% from peak
items.quote: Definitely, you will see in coming months, huh? You might see in coming months.

items.statement: Aggregate capex to reach approximately USD1.2 billion by end of next year; planned capex pipeline of roughly USD5 billion by 2030
items.quote: By the end of next year, our aggregate capital expenditure will reach approximately USD1.2 billion. Looking further ahead, we have a planned capex pipeline of roughly USD5 billion by 2030

items.statement: JNPT expansion capex of approximately INR1,675 crores; first phase of new liquid capacity expected operational in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The total capex for this program is approximately INR1,675 crores, and the first phase of the new liquid capacity is expected to be operational in Q1 of FY27

items.statement: FY27 capex to reach USD1.2 billion; FY28 capex expected to be generally in the range of close to INR5,000 crores

items.statement: 15-year take-or-pay agreement with leading conglomerate for petroleum product handling at Pipavav, committed volumes exceeding 0.5 million metric tons per year

items.quote: The asset is anchored by a long-term exclusive terminaling agreement with Hindustan Petroleum, HPCL, which runs through 2038 and therefore providing strong revenue visibility

items.quote: Generally we do a 30% to 40% growth as far as throughput is concerned year-on-year. We continue to say so. So, I think we should do between 30% to 40% growth as far as throughput is concerned in this year also

items.statement: Business mix evolving to gas dominance at 55-45 or 60-40 (gas:liquid); ammonia to become important third segment
items.quote: I think gas will be more dominant going forward, but it will usually be 55-45 or 60-40. The higher, of course, would be gas

items.statement: Liquid terminal blended earning of INR3,000 per CBM regarded as very good; liquid terminals earn 100% of capacity regardless of physical occupancy
items.quote: Liquid business has to be generally seen as what is the earning per CBM of the capacity that the company has. So, that is what one has to look at. items.statement: Raised INR660 crores through Series 1 NCDs and INR1,030 crores through Series 2 NCDs (both NSE listed) to diversify funding base and lock in long-term capital
items.quote: During the year, we raised INR660 crores through Series 1 non-convertible debentures and INR1,030 crores through Series 2 NCDs, both were NSE listed

items.statement: Evaluating additional cryogenic gas tank at JNPT in range of 36,000-50,000 metric tons; no final decision taken
items.quote: We are also evaluating a further cryogenic gas tank at JNPT in the range of 36,000 to 50,000 metric tons, which would further deepen our gas handling capabilities on the West Coast. No final decision has been taken, but we are certainly evaluating it

items.statement: ITOCHU Corporation acquired initial 10% stake in Aegis Terminal Pipavav Limited (ammonia subsidiary) with plans to raise to 25% over next three years
items.quote: To strengthen our capabilities in this emerging segment, we welcomed ITOCHU Corporation of Japan as a strategic partner. items.statement: Management targets INR600-700 crore revenue in next 2.5-3 years, reiterating previous guidance
items.quote: we are very strongly seeing our vision and target of INR600 to INR700 crores of revenue in the next 2.5 to 3 years, which we also guided in the previous earnings call

items.statement: FY27 profitability to grow faster than revenue if Middle East logistics normalize
items.quote: opening of the Middle East market, the demand getting back to -- I mean the logistic getting back to normal would increase the profitability faster than the revenue growth because higher logistics costs have been the major impacting factor currently

items.statement: Medium-term target: INR600-800 crore revenue with 5-7% consolidated PAT margin
items.quote: we would really like to see our revenue grow to INR600 crores to INR800 crores first with decent profitability, which means around 5% to 7% of PAT on a consolidated level

items.statement: Mexico Q4 FY26 strong, growth momentum expected to continue; Middle East reconstruction seen as key demand driver
items.quote: we've had a very strong quarter in Mexico in this current quarter itself as last reported. And we still see strong growth opportunities in Mexico, especially

items.statement: Diversified across 35-40 countries; South Africa, Africa, Mexico, Australia, UK, Europe offset Middle East volatility
items.quote: South Africa, other parts of Africa, Mexico, Australia, UK, Europe. So, we had been always a diversified company in the aspect of our customer base

items.quote: we don't have an order pipeline as such and it is an inventory-led sales model. So, we have found the balance wherein we refurbish machines, keep our stock ready

items.quote: the higher currency volatility fluctuation and the geopolitical war insurance risk and what not, the freight cost impact has been absorbed by our P&L, which is why -- which has been the only and only reason for our degrowth in profitability

items.quote: Currently, I think we are very well placed and covered. We do not have any immediate plans to expand to new geographies immediately

items.statement: Revenue target of INR 1,000 crores by FY29 with ~40% turnover growth targeted for FY27
items.quote: The target we have set for this year is to increase our turnover by approximately 40%.

items.statement: Revenue aspiration of INR 1,000 crores by FY29 to be achieved in next three years

items.quote: Earlier our manpower deployment was 10,000 when we brought the IPO, our workforce strength was 10,000. As of today, I have crossed 11,000, who are currently on our payroll.

items.statement: Focus on profitable growth and sustained improvement in return ratios despite some lower-margin contracts creating operating leverage
items.quote: Our main objective is not just revenue growth, but profitable growth and a sustained improvement in return ratios and earnings.

items.statement: Transitioning from collect-and-pay to pay-and-collect model to improve working capital efficiency
items.quote: Second focus will be on the pay-and-collect model earlier we were working on the collect-and-pay model, now our effort will be to participate in those businesses which are in the pay-and-collect model.

items.statement: Strong demand in e-commerce, quick commerce, logistics, warehousing, manufacturing and facility management sectors
items.quote: Third focus will be on expansion in high-growth sectors like quick commerce, logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, and facility management, where demand is very strong.

items.statement: Expanding into higher-margin services: payroll outsourcing, compliance management, HR outsourcing, consultancy and white-collar hiring

items.statement: Competitive market risks mitigated by diversified client base across sectors and geographies
items.quote: If one sector drops, we are having a sustainable income, so we don't get any effect from whatever the changes are there.

items.statement: IPO completed in February 2026; net worth INR 3,751 lakh, cash INR 2,434 lakh, virtually debt-free balance sheet
items.quote: We ended financial year 2026 with net worth of INR3,751 lakh, cash and bank balance of INR2,434 lakh, and a virtually debt-free balance sheet.

items.statement: Acquisition strategy focused on workforce management, staffing and payroll companies with strong client bases
items.quote: Our focus is on acquiring companies related to workforce management, staffing, and payroll services. We are looking at companies whose work matches our company's profile.

items.statement: Geographic expansion into South and West India regions post-IPO
items.quote: After the IPO, we have also started business in the South and also started in the West. Our business has started in the West as well.

items.statement: Technology focus on HRMS platform, automation and compliance infrastructure without significant new investment
items.quote: Fifth, which will be a very important focus, will be on technology, operational excellence, HRMS platform, and automation, and on compliance infrastructure. We don't have to invest we already have the infrastructure.

items.statement: Management evaluates opportunities based on EPS, ROE, ROCE impact and long-term shareholder value creation
items.quote: While evaluating growth opportunities, management's focus is on sustainable and profitable growth along with revenue growth. items.quote: They should be around 4-5% for FY26 and move above 5% for FY27.

items.quote: We have 21 crores in work-in-progress, and in the next year, we will invest another 10-15 crores in capex.

items.quote: We expect finance costs to be around 4% of turnover.

items.quote: Our inventory levels improved from 150 days last year to 130 days currently.

items.quote: As I have shared in last conference call also that our budgeted CAPEX plan for financial year 2026-27 is 77.45 crores and our corresponding bank debt will be availed accordingly.

items.quote: We are very happy to share we have received a very high volume, huge project from Kawasaki Japan wherein there are 15 parts which will come to us and one part has already started.

items.quote: Our EBITDA margins have grown from 94.94 crores, which was 22.34% to 229.16 crores, which is 25.21%, representing a growth of almost 36%.

items.quote: Our target is to by 2027, we want to get to 10,000 to 11,000 barrels and then by 2028, 22,000 barrels of oil and then by 2029, to 32,000 barrels of oil equivalent.

items.statement: Active pipeline of 20 wells in various stages of preparation across offshore and onshore assets for next 3 years
items.quote: We have an active pipeline comprising multiple drilling campaigns. So, as we speak, we would have 20 wells, which are in various stages of being prepared for execution, infrastructure expansion initiatives, and a production ramp-up planned across our offshore and onshore assets.

items.statement: Standalone lifting cost stable at $28.4/boe in FY26 vs $28.6/boe in FY25
items.quote: If you look at the lifting cost, it's $28.4 a barrel actually, which compares well with the previous year, which is again $28.6 a barrel.

items.statement: Strong gas demand in Assam; Dirok production choked back to 0.3-0.4 mmscmd from 1.1+ mmscmd capacity due to pipeline constraints
items.quote: As we speak, we have -- we are producing around 0.3 million to 0.4 million standard cubic meters per day. A few years ago, we were producing 1-plus million standard cubic meters from this, and we can still do that because those wells have been choked back.

items.statement: Targets Rs 6,000 crore revenue by FY30 (Rs 4,000 crore B2B, Rs 2,000 crore B2C) with 5% EBITDA margin and 4% PAT margin
items.quote: We remain confident on our long-term vision and continue to target 6,000 crores of revenue by Financial Year 2030, comprising 4,000 crores from B2B Retailer Shakti and 2,000 crores from B2C Operations by Sasta Sundar App, while progressively improving EBITDA margin and maintaining industry-leading working capital effic

items.statement: Retailer Shakti EBITDA margin guidance of 1% for FY27 maintained
items.quote: Retailer Shakti, yes. Retailer Shakti, yes, yes. That is true.

items.statement: Planned capex of Rs 234 crore for new warehouses (Udaipur, Lucknow, Patna, Guwahati, Baruipur); Rs 134 crore debt, Rs 100 crore from treasury
items.quote: So the total capex we have planned is 234 crores. Out of that, 134 crores we plan to take as bank loans, and around 100 crores we plan to deploy from the treasury.

items.statement: FY26 gross margin improved 100 bps to 7.5%; EBITDA loss narrowed to Rs 65 crore (margin -5%) from Rs 79 crore (-7.3%)
items.quote: Gross profit increased by 36.5% year-on-year to 96.5 crore while gross margin improved by nearly 100 basis point to 7.5% from 6.5% of last year. EBITDA losses reduced significantly from 79 crore in FY25 to 65 crores in FY26 with EBITDA margin improving from negative 7.3% to negative 5%.

items.statement: JITO private label margins expected at 30-40%+; meaningful contribution from Q3-Q4 FY27
items.quote: Margins are very heavy because these are private-label brands. So, margins will range from 30% to 40% plus.

items.statement: B2B Retailer Shakti grew at ~78% CAGR since 2019; now serves 62,000+ pharmacies with 700+ pharma partners
items.quote: Since financing in 2019, the business has compounded at nearly 78% CAGR and now sells over 62,000 retail pharmacies, while partnering with more than 700 pharmaceutical companies.

items.statement: Demerger: Microsec Resources to be listed separately with ~Rs 140 cr assets (Rs 100 cr financial, Rs 40 cr real estate); HealthX retains Rs 400 cr treasury for growth
items.quote: Microsec Resources will have an asset base of around, subject to exact calculation, around ₹140 crores. Out of this ₹140 crores, around ₹100 crores will be financial assets in terms of investments, and ₹40 crores, at book value, are real estate.

items.statement: Working capital cycle 18 days (~5% of sales); capital employed Rs 74 cr; cash & FD Rs 30 cr (ex-treasury)
items.quote: We maintain 18 days working capital efficiency representing approximately 5% annual sales while capital employed is roughly Rs. 74 crores. We also have a cash balance of approximately Rs. 30 crores.

items.statement: C&I segment revenue expected to cross Rs 1,000 crore in FY27, driven by volume-led growth across wires, switchgear, lighting and fans
items.quote: yes, we should be looking at 1,000 crores of revenue this year, but normally I would not give a specific number, but yes, I think we are moving in that direction, and I think we should be looking to cross that.

items.statement: Order book stands at over Rs 3,200 crore as of 22 May 2026, with smart metering accounting for more than 97%
items.quote: Our order book continues to provide visibility with metering, accounting for more than 97% of the order book of over Rs. 3,200 crores as of 22nd May 26.

items.statement: FY27 capex expected to be mainly maintenance capex after substantial capacity additions in prior years
items.quote: this year we are expecting the capex to be mainly on, on the maintenance, basically the maintenance capex.

items.statement: Smart metering EBIT margin ~17.5% in Q4 FY26; C&I margins pressured by higher wire share and commodity cost lag, expected to recover as price hikes take effect
items.quote: If you see even on the Q4 EBIT, it's almost 17.5% on the, on the smart metering part. So those are there.

items.statement: Price increases implemented in C&I (lighting, switchgear, fans) from April-May 2026 to pass through higher commodity costs; wire prices already passed on
items.quote: we have seen an increase in the industrial plastics, in the metals, all across, that has gone up. And, so there, the price increases got passed on in the first... by end of April and beginning of May, they got passed on.

items.statement: Smart metering demand intact; Q1 FY27 execution trend similar to Q4 FY26; industry installed ~7 crore of 22 crore sanctioned meters, with 15+ crore tendered
items.quote: overall, I see the demand being intact. And, I think the government's, you know, target of... I think they've extended the date to 2028, somewhere in March. So I think that seems to be possible.

items.statement: Wires & cables grew 50% to Rs 340 crore in FY26, volume-led; C&I share rose to 43% of revenue; new switch range launched, channel expansion continuing
items.quote: Within C&I, wires and cables was a standout performer, growing 50% in FY26 to 340 crores. The quality of this growth is encouraging, because it becomes broader and more volume-led.

items.statement: Promoter pledge of 2.42% unrelated to capex, expected to reduce in coming quarters; no major supply chain headwinds currently
items.quote: it is about 2.42%, I think, yeah. So I think we expect that to be reduced in the, in the coming quarters, yeah. Okay. But nothing related to the capex on that.

items.statement: International metering expansion targeting Middle East, SAARC, Africa over next 3-4 years; working on IEC specifications
items.quote: in the next 3-4 years, we should cover a lot of the addressable market, what our kind of specifications can reach out to.

items.statement: Debt levels expected to remain stable in FY27 despite revenue growth, as major capex cycle completed
items.quote: I don't see the debt going up, you know, I would say that it would remain somewhere in the same levels right now.

items.statement: Secured new business awards from major OEMs with cumulative lifetime revenue of INR 1,500 crores over existing order book
items.quote: These programs extend our business visibility well into the next decade and represent a cumulative lifetime revenue of approximately INR1,500 crores over and above our existing order book.

items.statement: Plans to invest INR 100-120 crores over next 3 years in foundry, machine shop, automation and advanced manufacturing
items.quote: Over the next 3 years, PCL plans to invest over INR 100 crores in foundry and machine shop capacity expansion, advanced manufacturing technologies as well as automation.

items.statement: Expects incremental revenue of 1.5x-2x capex annually at peak utilization in 2.5-3 years
items.quote: we expect that the top line increase -- incremental top line increase would be nearly 1.5x to 2x of that capex on an annualized basis, which will peak out in, let's say, 2.5 to 3 years from now

items.statement: Automation and higher-value assembled camshaft programs expected to improve EBITDA margins slightly, but difficult to quantify
items.quote: There should be slightly. Anyway, the new projects are all assembled camshafts. They are higher value add, therefore, higher margin. And also with the automation, we expect that EBITDA margin improves a little bit

items.statement: Strong demand visibility across India, North America, South America; assembled camshafts and precision engineered products opportunities expanding
items.quote: Demand visibility remains strong across India, North America and South America, while opportunities for assembled camshafts and precision engineered products continues to expand.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 standalone revenue INR 162 crores (+6.5% QoQ), EBITDA margin 15%, PAT margin 8%; consolidated revenue INR 205 crores (+9% QoQ), EBITDA 15%, PAT 4.9%
items.quote: The stand-alone business increased by 6.5% quarter-on-quarter to INR162 crores. EBITDA margin stood at 15%, PAT margin stood at 8%. The consolidated business grew by 9% quarter-on-quarter to INR205 crores. EBITDA margin stood at INR30 crores or 15% and PAT margin stood at 4.9%.

items.statement: FY26 profit INR 5.78 crores includes INR 48.8 crores exceptional charge for MFT subsidiary impairment (insolvency in Germany)
items.quote: For the full year of FY '26, company reported a profit of INR 5.78 crores. This performance includes an exceptional charge of INR48.8 crores related to the impairment of investment in our step-down subsidiary, MFT, which is currently undergoing insolvency proceedings in Germany.

items.statement: Revenue and capacity utilization expected to grow 15-20% in FY27, with both metrics moving in line
items.quote: According to me, it seems that it will increase by around 15–20%.

items.statement: Medium-term growth target of 60-80% over next 4-5 years
items.quote: We are planning to achieve growth of around 60% to 80%, or even 70% to 80%, over the next four to five years.

items.statement: Targeting industrial customers to drive utilization; industrial sales increasing due to ARAI certifications
items.quote: We are also targeting industries, and that will be visible in the next results as well. You will see that we have done good business/work with industries too.

items.statement: Plant setup cost at ~30% of peers; yield >99% vs industry 97-98%; zero-debt target via promoter share sales
items.quote: Compared to other biodiesel manufacturing units in India, I am able to set up a plant at around 30% of their investment cost, and that is my biggest strength.

items.statement: Sufficient storage capacity; no plans for additional storage; own vehicles for finished goods logistics
items.quote: Sir, we do not need any additional storage. We already have sufficient storage capacity for that quantity. As of now, there are no plans for additional storage. If the need arises in the future, then we will do it.

items.statement: FMCG business performing well across all markets
items.quote: Absolutely, absolutely. It is doing well everywhere, across all markets.

items.statement: Industrial biodiesel margins improved significantly; selling price not disclosed
items.quote: Our margins have increased. I will not disclose the price at which we are selling it, but the margins have improved quite significantly, that is all I can say.

name: Denta Water and Infra Solutions Ltd

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance of minimum 20%
items.quote: There will be 20% growth in revenue, that is the minimum revenue projections which we are having.

items.statement: Order book of Rs 7,278 million across 38 projects as of March 31, 2026
items.quote: As of March 31, 2026, our outstanding order books stood at approximately 7,278 million across 38 ongoing projects providing strong revenue visibility for the coming years.

items.statement: Bidding on 5-6 tenders worth ~Rs 600 crore
items.quote: Around 5 to 6 projects valued at around Rs. 600 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA margin dipped to 19% in Q4 FY26 from 33% in first three quarters
items.quote: In this quarter, we had a bit of a pressure, and our margins went down to 19%.

items.statement: Raw material costs (UPVC/HDP pipes) increased 20-30% in Q4 FY26 and April-May due to petroleum price rise
items.quote: Our 20% to 30% of the raw material is UPVC pipe and HDP pipe, which are dependent on petroleum products. And the prices have got increased in the 4th Quarter and also in the month of April and May.

items.statement: Price escalation clauses exist for projects >Rs 100 crore
items.quote: Yes, almost all projects more than 100 crores we have got price escalation. Less than 100 crores, we don't have price escalation.

items.statement: New Karnataka government aggressively pushing water infrastructure; Jal Jeevan Mission and AMRUT 2 driving tender pipeline
items.quote: The Jal Jivan Mission has been pushed aggressively by the government in its latest budget speech. And our project mix is Jal Jivan Mission and Amrut 2 scheme and also under Swachh Bharat, we have banked new establishment of new ST Ps.

items.statement: Adopting NEBR and CAMUS technologies for STPs achieving 95% purity; subcontracting patented tech
items.quote: In this field, we are adopting new technologies like NEBR technology and CAMUS based technologies with which we will be able to achieve almost 95% purity in treatment of sewage water.

items.statement: Inventory investment for project execution; materials laid on ground convert to billing at 55% supply, 35% laying, 10% completion
items.quote: Once we lay on the ground, actually for supply, we get around 55% of the material which we have supplied like pipes, pumps and, etc. And once we lay, we get the balance 35%.

items.statement: Revenue growth projection of 20-25% for FY27 with focus on absolute profit growth
items.quote: We hope to achieve a good revenue projection of around 20% to 25%. We hope to achieve a higher figure. And in absolute terms, we hope to have a very good profit
